column6: Kill an Aberrant Spectre.
column10: Equipping a nose peg or slayer helmet is required when fighting aberrant spectres. | With either of these items equipped, the challenge is as simple as killing any aberrant spectre. | Aberrant spectres in the Slayer Tower can be killed regardless of whether or not you are on task, whilst the ones in the Stronghold Slayer Cave cannot be killed unless on an aberrant spectre Slayer task. | With 67 Sailing, the aberrant spectres on Deepfin Point can be killed without a slayer task. | Notably, this location is the only place where skillers can obtain this combat achievement.

column6: Kill the Abyssal Sire 20 times.
Kill the Abyssal Sire 50 times.
Kill the Abyssal Sire without letting any Scion mature.
column10: This is considered one of the more difficult of the hard combat achievements. | Spawns can appear during each phase of the fight, have 15 hitpoints and mature after 12 seconds. | These will appear throughout the fight. | In phase 1, spawns will appear if the Sire is within attack range (~10 spaces), though it tends to frequently launch miasma pools. | This should not be an issue as players should be using shadow spells to disorient it, and will mostly remain outside of this range. | In phase 2, spawns will appear rather infrequently, but will have a much greater chance of being launched if the player is out of melee distance. | As such, stay within melee distance to minimise the chances of spawns appearing. | At this stage or before the end of phase 3, it may be beneficial to use Emberlight or Bandos godsword special attacks to drain the Sire's defence, to reduce the chance of attacks missing before he can be killed. | In phase 3, part 1, four spawns will appear immediately once the Sire roots itself to the ground and becomes attackable again. | These spawns must be killed immediately, and can be stacked by moving a few tiles back. | After these spawns are killed, the player can take a short breather, as no further spawns will appear until the next part begins. | Once the Sire reaches 140 or lower health, it will begin the second part of the phase, summoning a large cluster of spawns directly underneath it while more appear from both it and the surrounding area. | These spawns will need to be ignored, as they appear rapidly until the cap of 15 is hit. | The spawns are also linked to the phase's miasma pools; if the minion cap is not reached, then the Sire will continually launch miasma pools until the cap is met. | Enough damage must be dealt in 12 seconds; using the tips below can also be helpful in obtaining the achievement. | Advanced tips: | Without access to chinchompas or barrage spells it is still possible to kill all 4 spawns in phase 3 via ranged or magic, with some luck. | With access, try to target the central spawn of the pack. | Some ways to kill the spawns are using Venator bow, Hallowfell, or Dinh's bulwarks special attack. | After the 4 spawns are killed, no more will appear until after the teleport, giving an opportunity to prepare. | The teleport will occur when the Sire goes down to 139 hitpoints, and the following explosion can hit the player for up to 96 damage. | If using Vengeance, overheal with an anglerfish and cast Vengeance right before reducing the Sire below 139 hitpoints. | If the explosion reduces you to low health beware of dying from the spawns and miasma pools. | After the explosion run back to the Sire and dump specs while continuing to run 2 tiles back and forth to avoid the miasma pools. | The best special attack weapons for this in order are dragon claws, Voidwaker, burning claws, crystal halberd (final attack only), and dragon dagger. | It is not completely necessary to kill the spawns in phase 3-1, especially if his defence has been lowered. | By entering phase 3 quickly and attacking during his animation, the spawns can appear as phase 3-2 begins and special attacks can be dumped all at once before any have a chance to mature.

column6: Kill the Abyssal Sire after only stunning him once.
column10: The scorching bow trivialises this achievement, as it will always kill the respiratory systems in one shot, regardless of Ranged accuracy and ammo used. | For players without a scorching bow, note that upon a successful hit, players will always hit at least 50% of their maximum hit on the systems, meaning a setup with a maximum hit close to 50 will always kill the systems in 2 shots. | Additionally, the bonuses from a Slayer helm apply to the respiratory systems. | With high levels in either Magic or Ranged and late-game gear (such as a bow of Faerdhinen and full crystal armour), it is possible to kill all four in a single stun, but it will require minimising the time taken to travel between systems, such as running to the next system immediately after the player receives an experience drop that confirms they killed the previous system. | A Magic or Ranged weapon that can fire at a range of 10, including those that can use the longrange attack style, can be used to safespot the respiratory systems in the south-west and north-east of each boss chamber without the tentacles being able to attack. | To do this, wake up Sire but do not stun it. | Safespot the first two respiratory systems, then stun Sire and quickly kill the remaining systems before Sire can wake. | If three systems can be killed in the duration of one stun, then only one system need to be safespotted. | Alternatively using thralls; either Resurrect Greater Ghost or Resurrect Greater Skeleton from the Arceuus Spellbook, can slowly, but reliably take down the vents, even when the Abyssal Sire is not disoriented and without using shadow spells.

column6: Kill the Abyssal Sire without being hit by any external tentacles.
Use the Vengeance spell to reflect the damage from the Abyssal Sire's explosion back to him.
column10: In order to cast shadow spells to disorient the Sire, the player must use Spellbook Swap to swap to the Ancient spellbook. | The explosion attack can deal up to 96 damage, so it is highly recommended to have as many Hitpoints as possible and boost it with a Saradomin brew or Anglerfish. | It is also recommended to kill the four spawns that appear when the Sire roots itself to avoid having them waste Vengeance. | Staying alive is not required for successfully completing the achievement, so you can also try this without a lot of health. | Another account can also cast Vengeance Other on you, and it will count toward this combat achievement, eliminating the need for a way to change spellbooks. | The other account does not have to be on an Abyssal demon Slayer task to do this. | Since the fight does not stop if you teleport out, another strategy is to start the fight with the Ancient spellbook, kill the scions at the beginning of phase 3, teleport out, switch to the Lunar spellbook, come back and cast the vengeance. | It is recommended that you have a Lunar Altar in your POH if doing this strategy, since taking too long to come back can make the fight reset.

column6: Kill the Abyssal Sire without taking damage from any miasma pools.
column10: Miasma pools have a one second delay before they damage the player and have a 3x3 AoE from their initial spawn point. | They will disappear after a few seconds. | During phase 3, the player should trigger the pool on a location other than the south-west safe tile prior to starting the next stage when the Sire falls below 140 health, as it will perform its explosion attack once this threshold is triggered. | While the player is safe from damage for a few seconds, it also locks them in place slightly longer, which could result in damage from a pool.

column6: Kill the Abyssal Sire without taking damage from the external tentacles, miasma pools, explosion or damage from the Abyssal Sire without praying the appropriate protection prayer.
Kill Kree'arra 50 times.
Kill Kree'arra 100 times.
Kill Kree'arra in a private instance without ever attacking him directly.
column10: This can be achieved with chinchompas easily. | Recoil damage through Vengeance, especially enhanced with Dharok the Wretched's equipment with amulet of the damned, ring of suffering, and barrage spells may also be used, but they are less effective overall. | Beware that simply targeting Kree'arra, even while on attack cooldown, to prevent him from using his melee attack will automatically fail the task.

column6: Finish off Kree'arra whilst all of his bodyguards are dead.
column10: A good method to complete this task solo, alongside the similar tasks for each of the respective God Wars Dungeon bosses, is to use a Toxic blowpipe alongside a Serpentine helm to envenom the bodyguards between kills, so that when the boss is low on health all of the minions are also low/dead, allowing them to be killed easier.

column6: Kill Kree'arra in a private instance without taking any melee damage from the boss or his bodyguards.
column10: Although killing Kree'arra using Protect from Melee would complete this task, Kree'arra consistently hits high damage with ranged so this is not recommended. | Kree'arra only closes in for melee attacks if he is not presently targeted, so if distance is maintained while using Protect from Missiles, the only threat for melee damage will be Flight Kilisa. | Flight Kilisa only has level 50 Magic and no magic defence, so she can be bound with magic fairly reliably. | If you're having trouble binding Flight Kilisa, it's possible to toggle Protect from Melee only while Flight Kilisa is alive and killing her by immediately stepping under Kree'arra. | Once Flight Kilisa dies, quickly turn your prayers back to Protect from Missiles and Rigour and step out of Kree'arra to damage him. | Repeat the previous process when Flight Kilisa respawns, 2 or 3 repetitions should be enough to complete the combat achievement. | Tagging Flight Kilisa and Kree'arra using RuneLite makes this process easier by showing you their tiles and helping you quickly noticing respawns. | Alternatively, players will usually complete this task passively by the time they get to 100 kills, as long as Kree'arra is fought in a private instance each time. | Simply stay out of Kree'arra's melee range and minimise Kilisa's accuracy against the player by using strong armour and a super defence or bastion potion.

column6: Kill Kree'arra by only dealing damage to him with a salamander.
column10: The tecu salamander is recommended, as it is the strongest salamander available, requiring irit tar as ammo and level 80 Attack, Ranged, and Magic to use. | Players should use the salamander in melee mode, as it hits significantly harder than ranged and Kree'arra has slightly less melee defence compared to ranged. | It is also very recommended to bring a mix of strong defensive equipment with high defence bonuses in all three styles, while also trying to maximise strength and slash bonuses, as Ranged accuracy will only be around 20% with a salamander. | Oathplate armour and the bellator ring should be used over other options in order to increase slash accuracy. | The inventory should consist of about 200 irit tars, multiple super combat potions, a crossbow and grapple, and as many Saradomin brews and super restores as possible. | Players should keep Protect from Missiles and Piety on at all times. | It is also advised to walk under Kree'arra after every attack to minimise his overall attacks, as he has an attack speed of 3, whereas the salamanders have an attack speed of 5 when used on the scorch (melee) style. | With an aviansie slayer task, using a slayer helmet will make the achievement much easier. | Note: As the players can only use salamanders to kill Kree'arra, any other types of damage such as thralls or recoil damage will automatically fail the achievement.

column6: Kill Kree'arra 30 times in a private instance without leaving the room.
column10: It is recommended to use either a Tumeken's shadow or the chinchompa method. | Having an aviansies slayer task will be a huge benefit. | Kree is the only God Wars Dungeon boss not to drop any prayer restoration, so players will need to bring at least eight prayer potions/prayer regeneration potions. | Expect the achievement to take around 65 minutes. | First, pre-pot with an anglerfish and a super defence potion. | If using a Tumeken's shadow, also bring runes for blood barrage and bones to peaches tabs; optionally take an eldritch Nightmare staff and ice barrage. | Start each kill in the south-west corner of the room and freeze Flight Kilisa whenever possible (or alternatively step under Kree after each attack). | If you need to heal during a kill, step under Kree. | Once Kree dies, blood barrage both Kilisa and Flockleader Geerin to restore any lost health and use the eldritch staff's special attack on Skree to restore prayer. | Bring bones to peaches tabs, as the resulting peaches will restore 32 health per spawn cycle. | If the player does not have a Tumeken's shadow or chinchompas, it is also possible to complete the achievement with a bow of Faerdhinen or twisted bow; however, since the player has lower damage in this setup, a Slayer task is necessary. | Properly prayer flicking the bodyguards when the boss is dead to fully heal with blood barrage after every kill is important, since you take a lot of damage. | Walking under the boss when your weapon is on cooldown or when eating reduces damage taken from Kree'arra. | Bones to peaches tabs are also important, and the blood ancient sceptre allows you to overheal for each kill. | Since the player deals less damage than with the recommended setups, the player must rely more on healing in the room and bring more Prayer restoration. | 12 super restores, 4 ranging potions, and 2 prayer regeneration potions are enough to last 30 kills, if the player utilises the Armadyl altar that restores Prayer fully every ten minutes. | Bring 4 or 5 Saradomin brews to allow for more healing and boost your Defence, depending on if you have an ecumenical key or killcount to access the boss. | Kree'arra's bodyguards drop the occasional batch of manta rays and mushroom potatoes, but don't fully rely on these to last the entire trip. | Super defence potion drops can be useful to tank during kills.

column6: Kill General Graardor 50 times.
Kill General Graardor 100 times.
Kill General Graardor whilst he is immobilized[sic].
column10: For the purposes of this task, bind spells from the standard spellbook or ice spells from the ancient spellbook are recommended. | The Zamorak godsword could also be used for this task, although if the player is aiming for Ourg Freezer II, it is recommended to use ice spells to complete both achievements at once.

column6: Kill General Graardor without him attacking any players.
column10: This achievement is best combined with Ourg Freezer, as the player has to bind Graardor to kill him anyway. | Alternatively, the Ranged method using an Armadyl crossbow or Bow of Faerdhinen will complete this task if performed flawlessly. | This option will not complete Ourg Freezer.

column6: Finish off General Graardor whilst all of his bodyguards are dead.
column10: A good method to complete this task solo, alongside the similar tasks for each of the respective God Wars Dungeon bosses, is to use a Toxic blowpipe alongside a Serpentine helm to envenom the bodyguards between kills, so that when the boss is low on health all of the minions are also low/dead, allowing them to be killed easier.

column6: Kill General Graardor 2 times consecutively in a private instance without taking any damage from his bodyguards.
column10: Prayer Flick Method | Prayer flick the bodyguards' attacks; ideally try to make Sergeant Strongstack hit on the same tick as Graardor so both attacks are blocked. | Make sure that Sergeant Steelwill and Sergeant Grimspike also attack on different ticks. | Graardor has an attack speed of 6 (3.6s) while the bodyguards have an attack speed of 5 (3.0s). | Walking under Graardor can help resync off-ticks. | An adaptation that might be easier but requires extended focus is to keep the minions alive after killing Graardor once, then focus on flicking them correctly without killing them as Graardor respawns. | By wearing powerful defensive armour such as Justiciar armour or Torva armour, and using an Osmumten's fang with a strong shield such as the elysian spirit shield or dragonfire shield, it should be possible to tank and kill Graardor twice with a decent amount of healing supplies. | Players with knowledge of the 5:0 Tumeken's shadow strategy may opt to do a modified version of it for the achievement: | Kill Graardor normally, then kill Strongstack and Grimspike. | First kill: As Graardor respawns, kill Steelwill, then pray Protect from Missiles and do the 5:0 method to avoid both Graardor and Strongstack. | Continue to 5:0 after Graardor is dead in order to kill Strongstack. | Second kill: As Graardor respawns, kill Grimspike, then pray Protect from Magic and do the 5:0 method again. | Setup (No-Flick) Method | This method is less dependent on execution but depends heavily on a DPS check. | An active slayer task/helm on top of maximum dps mage gear are key to succeeding. | Ice ancient sceptre and Tumeken's shadow are highly recommended. | Kill General Graardor normally, leave alive Sergeant Steelwill (Mage) with the minimum HP possible. | Wait for General Graardor to respawn while sitting in the north east corner. | This is the setup before your first perfect kill. | When General Graardor spawns, switch to ranged prayer and freeze him immediately. | Failures to freeze make success unlikely. | With your prayer now on ranged, you are relying on your max mage bonus and defence bonuses to negate a few mage attacks. | When Sergeant Strongstack spawns, freeze him as well. | Failures to freeze make success unlikely. | Kill the low-health Sergeant Steelwill. | Failures to kill him on the first hit (before he damages you) make success unlikely. | With Sergeant Steelwill dead, you must race against his respawn timer to kill Graardor. | Graardor and strongstack will likely need a re-freeze before he is dead | Kill Seargent Strongstack. | To prep for the second perfect kill, leave Sergeant Grimspike alive with minimum health and wait in the north east corner with ranged prayer active. | When Graardor spawns, freeze him. | When Sergeant Strongstack spawns, freeze him as well. | Failures to freeze make success unlikely. | Kill the low-health Sergeant Grimspike, switch to magic prayer. | Kill general Graardor before Sergeant Grimspike respawns. | Graardor and Strongstack will likely need a re-freeze before he is dead | By setting it up this way, players frontload the hardest of the RNG checks and set up for the safest second kill. | By leaving Grimspike weakened and waiting in the North-East tile, players have additional time and a chance at Steelwill (the mage) being slow to aggro entirely, due to his south wall spawn.

column6: Kill General Graardor in a private instance without taking any damage from the boss or bodyguards.
column10: This achievement requires Ranged or Magic in order to complete, since Graardor's melee attacks are accurate even with best-in-slot melee armour. | Use Ice Barrage and the best magic equipment available to quickly kill Graardor, or try to flick the minions while using one of the methods that prevents Graardor from attacking (e.g., 5:0 with a Tumeken's shadow). | Freezing Sergeant Strongstack is helpful but not needed, since he will usually be trailing with Graardor. | Make sure that both Sergeant Grimspike and Sergeant Steelwill are attacking on different ticks, so their attacks can be flicked against, since both are fairly accurate even with good defensive bonuses. | One method that can be used to make this achievement easier is to keep the minions alive but at low health after killing Graardor. | Just as Graardor respawns, kill whatever spawns closest to the player's position, then freeze Sergeant Grimspike in a good location so the remaining long-ranged minion has to be prayed against. | If the kill seems to be dragging on, the remaining minion can be killed before the other long-ranged minion respawns.

column6: Kill General Graardor 15 times in a private instance without leaving the room.
column10: Using either the magic freezing method, ranged method or even just face-tanking with an elysian spirit shield and Justiciar armour, this task can easily be completed with very little prior experience in fighting General Graardor. | If melee is being used, flicking the mage minion every other attack, might increase chances for success. | Since General Graardor drops super restores relatively commonly, having a little bit of luck should be enough to complete this task without much practice.

column6: Open the Barrows chest 10 times.
column10: This combat achievement can be finished quickly by running through the barrows and finding out which sarcophagus enters into the tunnel, disregarding any brother that appears. | This method yields around 30-50 chest openings per hour. | Note that almost no loot will be received using this method. | It is the fastest way to get killcount, however. | With the Strange old lockpick, players can ignore the random path and head straight into the middle room, making trips faster at the cost of a charge when passing through a locked door.

column6: Open the Barrows chest 25 times.
column10: This combat achievement can be finished quickly by running through the barrows and finding out which sarcophagus enters into the tunnel, disregarding any brother that appears. | This method yields around 30-50 chest openings per hour. | Note that almost no loot will be received using this method. | It is the fastest way to get killcount, however. | With the Strange old lockpick, players can ignore the random path and head straight into the middle room, making trips faster at the cost of a charge when passing through a locked door.

column6: Kill Dharok, Verac, Torag and Guthan without letting them attack you with melee.
column10: To complete this task, it is recommended to keep doing Barrows runs, starting with Ahrim and Karil, until one of these two is in the entrance to the tunnels. | After that, the exact same strategy can be applied to all four remaining brothers. | For these melee brothers, the general strategy is to search the coffin and then immediately run to the opposite side of their coffin. | Due to the small delay before a brother attacks, it is even possible to run through the brother when running to the other side of the coffin. | The special attack of a dragon spear can be used to stun the brothers should this prove difficult. | Turn off run energy, and cast the best freezing spell available, such as Ice spells or Entangle. | Then immediately run back, in case the freeze splashes. | If the freeze succeeds, cast a few damaging spells, and be sure to hide behind the coffin before it runs out. | Repeat this strategy every time the freeze runs out. | Then repeat the strategy for all four brothers, and open the final chest to complete the task. | The combat achievement is awarded once the chest is opened after killing all four melee-based brothers without being hit. | Note that the brothers will prefer to walk east-west, meaning that it is generally easier to trap the brother on either the north or the south side of the coffin. | It can also be useful to use the 'Ctrl+click' command to run when run is turned off. | If the player gets hit, the player cannot simply leave the crypt and try again, as the hit counter is only reset once the chest is looted. | Another strategy, without freezing, consists in using a trident of the swamp with a serpentine helm. | Start the kill and run to the opposite side of the coffin. | Get some distance, hit once, and run again to the opposite side of the coffin. | Then let the venom kill each brother.

column6: Kill all six Barrows Brothers and loot the Barrows chest without taking any damage from any of the brothers.
column10: As the name suggests, the task is easiest completed by using protection prayers during the fights. | Using Protect from Magic when fighting Ahrim the Blighted, Protect from missiles when fighting Karil the Tainted, and Protect from Melee when fighting Dharok the Wretched, Guthan the Infested, Torag the Corrupted and Verac the Defiled. | It is however possible for Verac to hit through Protect from Melee, thus players should consider binding him with binding spells like Entangle or ice spells to minimise the chance of him landing a damaging hit. | When spawning Verac, use a Dragon spear special attack to stun him or immediately run behind the coffin to avoid getting hit. | Once the player has taken damage from a brother, the chest must be found and looted before another attempt is made. | This applies even to the first brother fought; leaving the room to reset the fight does not allow this task to be completed even if all six brothers are subsequently killed without damaging the player. | Players should also take the prayer-drain effect in the Barrows into consideration and bring some means of prayer restoration like Prayer potions.

column6: Kill any Barrows Brother using only magical damage.
column9: Combat Achievements/Easy;Barrows brothers;magic damage;Quests;Priest in Peril;Morytania
column10: Dharok the Wretched and Guthan the Infested both have negative magic defence. | Torag the Corrupted and Verac the Defiled are also very vulnerable to magic attacks. | Killing these brothers with magic is highly advisable, so completing this task is in line with the recommended strategy for killing the Barrows Brothers.

column6: Kill Karil using only damage dealt by special attacks.
column10: Using a lightbearer is recommended. | Players can also have a friend cast Energy Transfer on them to restore their special attack energy for this achievement, or wait in a safespot for their special attack energy to naturally recover. | Poison damage (from a Dragon dagger p++ for example), venom damage, as well as a charged Dragonfire Shield attack may be utilised. | The burn from burning claws or the Arkan blade will fail this achievement. | For lower levels, or Ironmen, the rune thrownaxe delivers moderate, reliable damage for only 10% special attack energy per throw. | Players should turn off auto-retaliate and click away after each throw as the rune thrownaxe has a relatively fast attack speed and it is easy to accidentally auto-attack Karil. | Normal attacks that do not deal damage do not count against this combat achievement.

column6: Kill all six Barrows Brothers and loot the Barrows chest without ever having more than 0 prayer points.
column10: If the player enters the first coffin room with any amount of prayer points, it will not count, even if all prayer points are drained before summoning the first brother. | The melee brothers can be frozen to reduce the amount of damage taken, leaving only Karil and Ahrim able to damage the player. | Note that the player cannot hop worlds when doing this achievement, as it checks both digging to enter the crypt, and the kill itself. | If the player dies while attempting this achievement, their stat reset on respawn will result in more than 0 prayer, causing the achievement to fail.

column6: Kill a Basilisk Knight.
Kill a Black Dragon.
column10: It is recommended to kill the King Black Dragon because it is part of another easy combat achievement, King Black Dragon Novice, to progress in two at once. | Players with level 77 Slayer may also opt to kill a brutal black dragon to complete medium task Brutal, Big, Black and Firey at the same time.

column6: Kill a Bloodveld.
column10: Bloodvelds require no specific equipment to be killed, but as their attacks are magic-based melee attacks, it is advisable to bring dragonhide gear if the player's combat stats are low. | The bloodvelds in the Stronghold Slayer Cave and Morytania Slayer Tower basement can only be hurt while on Slayer task, so unless the player's task is to kill bloodveld, another location has to be chosen.

column6: Kill a Brutal Black Dragon.
Open Bryophyta's chest once.
Open Bryophyta's chest 5 times.
Kill Bryophyta with the Protect from Magic prayer active.
column10: The prayer doesn't have to be used throughout the fight, but it has to be active when Bryophyta finishes her death animation and the loot appears on the ground.

column6: Kill all 3 of Bryophyta's growthlings within 3 seconds of the first one dying.
column10: To kill the growthlings, make all three of them stand directly adjacent to the player, then wield magic secateurs or an axe and attack all three in quick succession. | With sufficient food and/or prayer points, this achievement can be attempted multiple times during the same fight with Bryophyta.

column6: Kill Bryophyta without suffering any poison damage.
column10: Bryophyta does not poison on free-to-play worlds, so killing her on a free-to-play world will automatically complete this task. | This will also complete the Fighting as Intended II task. | Alternatively, if the player wishes to do this task on a members world, they can choose to bring an antipoison potion or protect from poison in another way.

column6: Kill Bryophyta with either poison or venom being the final source of damage.
column10: Players can wear a serpentine helm alongside a toxic blowpipe or trident of the swamp to guarantee that Bryophyta is inflicted with venom on the next successful hit, attack her until her health is low, and then wait for the venom to take effect. | Alternatively, any poison weapon can be used to apply regular poison. | If the player's combat stats are low, make sure to bring some extra supplies to outlast any extra attacks Bryophyta might inflict while waiting for the venom or poison to take effect.

column6: Kill Bryophyta on a free to play world.
column10: Level 37 Prayer or higher for the Protect from Magic prayer | If using Melee: | Level 50 Attack or higher | Level 50 Strength or higher | Level 50 Defence or higher | If using Ranged: | Level 60 Ranged or higher | Level 40 Defence or higher | If using Magic: | Level 59 Magic for Fire Blast or 35 Magic for Fire Bolt | Level 40 Defence or higher

column6: Kill Callisto 10 times.
Kill Callisto 20 times.
Kill Skotizo once.
Kill Skotizo 5 times.
Kill Skotizo with no altars active.
column10: Altars that activate after Skotizo is killed do not fail the task. | However, altars can activate immediately before the kill, failing the task. | Minimise this chance by verifying they are all down while dealing the last blow. | When an altar is destroyed, there is a one minute cooldown before that altar can re-activate again. | By letting all altars activate and then quickly destroying them, you can then safely finish off Skotizo with no risk of the altars reactivating.

column6: Kill Skotizo without taking any damage.
column10: In order to not take any damage the player must pray Protect from Magic and stay out of melee distance from Skotizo, the three reanimated demon spawns, and the dark ankou. | The dark ankou will only start following the player if the player gets too close. | Using a ranged weapon with a high attack range will make it easier to keep distance from the enemies while running. | Take Arclight or Emberlight to quickly kill the Awakened Altars. | Multi-target binds such as ice burst or ice barrage can be cast when the 3 demon spawns are grouped together in order to freeze them and allow the player to briefly stop and attack Skotizo. | Since this achievement requires a lot of running, several stamina potions should be taken. | The self-damaging effects of ruby dragon bolts (e), ruby bolts (e), and divine potions will not cause the achievement to fail. | When the reanimated demon spawns are following you in a line, you can also bind the first one in the line which stops them all as they cannot go through each other. | They can go through Skotizo, however. | You will still need to deal with the reanimated demon spawns as they will still spawn after 3 minutes. | Killing two of the reanimated demon spawns also prevents re-spawning them, so you only have to kite one of them. | Note: The awakened pillars no longer stop spawning after being active for 3 minutes.

column6: Kill Skotizo with a demonbane weapon equipped.
Kill Skotizo without equipping a demonbane weapon.
column10: The most effective way to complete this achievement is to use the twisted bow, for its increased power and accuracy against monsters with high Magic bonuses, such as Skotizo. | Players who do not own a twisted bow may instead opt to use regular melee attacks. | While this task prohibits equipping the Silverlight, Darklight, Arclight, Emberlight, Scorching bow or Burning Claws, it does not prohibit casting Demonbane spells, since those are not equipped weapons. | Additionally, Purging staff and Holy water are not considered to be demonbane weapons for this task. | The hardest part of this challenge is keeping the number of altars down to one or zero. | However, with sufficient stats and gear it can be navigated without too much difficulty, as the awakened altars have a cooldown of one minute once destroyed before they can reactivate. | Some tips: Death charge does NOT work on the awakened altars. | Greater corruption can be valuable when attacking Skotizo. | Having a demonbane weapon in the inventory to finish him off if you fail does not fail the challenge so can be worth it. | The Dark demonbane spell has a decent hitrate on Skotizo but the Undead Grasp spell does not, so planning on using the Blue Moon special attack on a frozen Skotizo is not a great idea; special attack energy is better spent on the pillars instead. | Thralls can also be helpful in killing Skotizo. | Neither the pillars nor Skotizo regain health, so for the pillars, it can be helpful to drain all of their health and kill them all at once in order to give time to kill Skotizo without worrying about the pillars defending him. | Also as a reminder, there are teleports out of his lair on all four corners in case you need them, and the spawns die at the end of the fight so you don't need to worry about clearing them. | Good luck!

column6: Kill Skotizo with the final source of damage being a Chinchompa explosion.
column10: The attack must not be targeted against Skotizo directly, but must be collateral damage from a reanimated demon spawn or dark ankou that is underneath or directly adjacent to Skotizo's south-west tile. | This is because Skotizo is larger than 1x1 so it will only receive collateral damage from area-of-effect attacks that hit its south-western tile. | The Scorching bow's special attack, Scorching shackles, will bind Skotizo in place for 20 ticks(12 seconds). | This can aid in positioning Skotizo to easily receive collateral damage from the reanimated demon spawn or dark ankou, but be careful that the burn damage does not accidentally deal the finishing blow.

column6: Kill Cerberus 75 times.
Kill Cerberus 150 times.
Kill Cerberus without any of the Summoned Souls being spawned.
column10: Cerberus summons souls every 7 attacks from the start of her attack rotation, but only when below 400 health. | With an attack speed of 6, or 3.6 seconds between attacks, she must be flinched and walked under in order to obtain the achievement; otherwise there won't be enough time to kill her within seven attacks. | Alternatively, the player can wait for Cerberus to attack 14 times before dropping her below 400 health, as the souls only appear when she falls below that threshold. | The next occurrence of this attack, attack 21, is overridden by her triple attack, which occurs every ten attacks from the first. | This means that the player has ~46.8 seconds to defeat Cerberus before the next set of souls appears with minimal walking. | With maximum flinching and walking, additional time can be provided at the start of the encounter. | Cerberus has a 10% chance to use a standard attack instead of summoning souls on her 7th attack, so if the player is able to consistently complete the kill before her 14th attack, eventually, this achievement will be completed passively. | See the Dharok's armour 'red-click' strategy for an additional method of completing this combat achievement.

column6: Kill Cerberus after successfully negating 6 or more attacks from Summoned Souls.
Kill Cerberus without taking damage from any lava pools.
column10: The lava pool attack is indicated when Cerberus growls "Grrrr", launching three markers around the arena - one on the player's position at the time the mechanic was initiated, and two around it. | It is recommended to use Ranged when attempting this achievement as the markers have a delay when launched at a distance, allowing the player to quickly move out of the way. | This attack is initiated when Cerberus falls below 200 health and is performed on every attack that ends in 0 or 5 on her attack rotation. | Alternatively, the player can simply kill Cerberus before she has a chance to use the mechanic.

column6: Kill Cerberus without taking any melee damage.
column10: This achievement is best done with Ranged as Cerberus does not actively move in to attack the player with melee. | This leaves her triple combo attack as the only threat, as the last hit deals melee damage and does not take distance into account.

column6: Kill the Chaos Elemental 10 times.
Kill the Chaos Elemental 25 times.
Kill the Chaos Elemental without it unequipping any of your items.
column10: The Chaos Elemental cannot unequip items as long as the player does not have the required inventory space for them to be unequipped. | Because of this, it is recommended to bring pies, stews, or curry as food, as they will leave behind a pie dish or bowl upon being eaten. | Alternatively, Saradomin brews can be brought instead, as long as the "smash vials" ability is not activated. | Note that Saradomin brews drain stats so bringing super restores would be advisable. | Failure only occurs if a player has an item removed from their equipment slots from the madness projectile. | If the player hit by the projectile does not have anything equipped, the combat task is still achievable. | This can be used with the Solo Safe Spot Method to guarantee task completion if the luring is done without any items equipped, even if there are slots available in the inventory.

column6: Kill the Chaos Elemental without taking any damage from its attacks.
column10: Given that the Chaos Elemental has a very long range and its attacks dealing either magic, ranged or melee damage with no distinction, it is quite difficult to draw its attention without getting hit. | Attacking with a 10-square attack range weapon while the Chaos Elemental is not facing the player and quickly running behind a safespot is an effective way to achieve this. | Wearing a full set of Verac the Defiled's equipment with the Protect Item prayer turned on is an excellent way to complete the achievement, since the full set allows players to bypass the Chaos Elemental's defences. | Praying Protect from Magic, the player should try to get the attention of the elemental, with a little luck, they should take no damage from potential ranged or melee attacks, whilst luring the Chaos Elemental towards the small trees outside the Rogues' Castle walls. | When the Chaos Elemental is in place, the player should start flinching it by attacking the elemental once, then immediately step back behind the tree, then wait for the elemental's HP bar to disappear before landing the next attack. | This should ensure that the Chaos Elemental has no chance to retaliate. | Alternatively, a Dwarf multicannon can be used to trigger the Chaos Elemental's aggression; in this case, it won't be necessary to step out of the cover of the tree except to make flinch attacks once the Chaos Elemental is trapped. | Depending on the specific position where the Chaos Elemental is trapped, it will also be possible to place the cannon such that its firing range is aligned with the Chaos Elemental's southwest tile; this will allow you to kill it significantly faster by virtue of double cannon shots. | Few supplies should be needed for this task, a prayer potion and combat potions plus some emergency food and teleport should be brought. | The rest of the inventory should be filled with cheap food that leaves items behind, like apple pies, in case the player gets hit by the Elemental's disarming attack, whilst not risking too much if attacked by a PK'er.

column6: Kill the Chaos Fanatic 10 times.
Kill the Chaos Fanatic 25 times.
Kill the Chaos Fanatic without anyone being hit by his explosion attack.
Kill the Chaos Fanatic 10 times without drinking any potion which restores prayer or leaving the Wilderness.
column10: This task prohibits the consumption of only the following items: | Prayer potion | Prayer regeneration potion (Consuming this will reset the task, but you are allowed to have the regeneration effect active while getting kills) | Zamorak brew | Super restore | Sanfew serum | Ancient brew | Moonlight moth mix | Stat Restore Pot Share of any of the above | This means it is allowed to make use of several other prayer-restoring items, which notably includes the Falador shields, and Moonlight moths (non-mix version). | Jangerberries, Bluefin, yellow spicy stew, and another player sharing a Moonlight moth mix can also be used, however these items are not recommended for practical use. | Players can also use the special attack on the Saradomin godsword or ancient mace to recharge their prayer, however due to the fanatic's high melee defences this is an unreliable way to restore prayer points. | The suggested strategy for completing this task is to make use of the Wilderness Obelisk network, after having completed the hard Wilderness Diary which allows players to set a custom destination. | Using these obelisks, players can teleport to the level 13 obelisk, then recharge their prayer at the altar just outside the Ferox Enclave, and then return to the level 44 obelisk to continue on the task. | Note that entering the Enclave does reset progress, so the altar just east of it needs to be used. | Players may opt instead to use the Chaos altar found in the deep Wilderness Chaos Temple, which is just south-west of the Chaos Fanatic. | However, due to this location being commonly patrolled by PKers and being a multicombat area, it is recommended to take more caution when using this altar. | F2P worlds don't have the problem of PKers in and around the chaos altar as using bones on altar is a member only feature. | The altar functions as a simple prayer altar instead. | Hopping to a f2p world is a viable option as a result. | Just note, members food items will not work on f2p worlds. | Also, if you're an Ironman, the first attack on the Chaos Fanatic after world hopping will not count as yours, so if it dies on that hit, the kill will not count. | Logging out or hopping worlds does not reset your progress.

column6: Kill the Corporeal Beast 25 times.
Kill the Corporeal Beast 50 times.
Kill the Corporeal Beast without anyone killing the dark core or taking damage from the dark core.
column10: This can be accomplished by moving 2 tiles whenever the dark energy core jumps towards the player. | Solo players should not bring a cannon as it will end up killing the core. | If the core would have damaged the player but the damage is nulled through teleporting, the achievement is still failed, and no failure message is received. | If teleporting out of the room mid kill, it is recommended to move away from the core first or to time the teleport such that the core could not have damaged the player throughout the length of the teleport animation.

column6: Finish off the Corporeal Beast with a Halberd special attack.
column9: Combat Achievements/Elite;Corporeal Beast;dragon halberd;crystal halberd;special attack;Attack Style

column6: Kill the Corporeal Beast solo.
column10: For non-ironmen players, it is recommended to complete the achievement using an instance - while this will cost money and requires another player to hold the instance, the Corporeal Beast has a lot of health and the player might get crashed by other players, particularly griefers, while attempting the task. | Ironmen players do not have to worry as much as they get their own room if they have a combat level of 90 or higher, although the room is still shared on that world with all other ironmen.

column6: Kill the Crazy Archaeologist 10 times.
Kill the Crazy Archaeologist 25 times.
Kill the Crazy Archaeologist with only magical attacks.
Kill the Crazy Archaeologist without anyone being hit by his "Rain of Knowledge" attack.
Kill a Demonic Gorilla.
column10: This task can be completed during the Monkey Madness II quest by damaging a demonic gorilla and having Nieve finish it off. | Alternatively, demonic gorillas can be found in the Crash Site Cavern after completing Monkey Madness II.

column6: Finish off a Demonic Gorilla with a demonbane weapon.
column10: This task can be completed very easily by using Arclight or Emberlight, and any of the demonbane spells with or without a purging staff, as both are easily accessible and ensures the gorilla can be dealt the last blow with a demonbane weapon regardless of what it prays against. | If using Ranged instead of Magic, it is possible that the last blow on the gorilla has to be done with a ranged weapon, in which case the scorching bow may be used instead. | If the player does not have either the bow or demonbane spells, killing just a few will likely result in being able to kill one with melee as the last attack style.

column6: Kill the Deranged Archaeologist 10 times.
Kill the Deranged Archaeologist 25 times.
Kill the Deranged Archaeologist with only magical attacks.
Kill the Deranged Archaeologist without anyone being hit by his "Learn to Read" attack.
column10: The easiest way to get this achievement is simply to choose two points in the boss area to run between special attacks. | Whenever he shouts "Learn to Read!", run to the opposite point in the area. | While it is possible to get unlucky and be hit by one of the smaller books, there's a good chance that the attack will be avoided entirely by giving a wide enough berth.

column6: Kill a Fire Giant.
column10: Fire giants are very easy to kill for low-level players with fairly decent food and equipment. | Players with a Prayer level of at least 43 can utilise Protect from Melee to negate all damage given from them. | Fire giants have a significant elemental weakness to water spells. | Players may also opt to safespot them with magic. | There are many areas with fire giants that include convenient safespots, such as the Brimhaven Dungeon, Stronghold Slayer Cave, and Waterfall Dungeon. | If all easy combat achievements are planned to be completed, it is efficient to kill a fire giant, moss giant, and a hill giant in the Giants' Den within the Shayzien region to complete this achievement and Into the Den of Giants at the same time.

column6: Kill Galvek in less than 3 minutes.
column10: The recommended strategy is to use a dragon crossbow (or better) with ruby dragon bolts (e), and a strong special attack weapon, such as a zaryte crossbow, voidwaker, or burning claws. | As Galvek's defence resets between phases, defence reduction is generally less effective here. | For players with weaker range equipment, using a strong melee weapon such as Osmumten's fang or a Dragon hunter lance for Galvek's final phase might be more effective. | For highest odds of successful completion, start the Galvek fight and instantly start clicking on where his character will spawn during the dark transition screen. | If the ruby bolts do not activate their special effect on the first attack, teleport back to the Myths' Guild with the mythical cape and restart. | When the ruby bolt special is activated on the first attack, prepare for an attempt at the goal time. | Use any special attacks immediately, and continue to range Galvek. | Food such as Guthix rests or Saradomin brews will avoid losing ticks | As Saradomin brew and Galvek both drain combat stats, Menaphite remedy is strongly recommended to passively restore stats. | A Surge potion for an extra special attack | For Ultimate Ironmen attempting this Combat Achievement, the fight against Galvek via Pool of Dreams in Myths' Guild is considered safe so excess items can be stored in death bank safely during this encounter.

column6: Kill the Grotesque Guardians 25 times.
Kill the Grotesque Guardians 50 times.
Kill the Grotesque Guardians without taking damage from Dusk's blinding attack.
Kill the Grotesque Guardians without taking damage from Dusk's prison attack.
Kill the Grotesque Guardians without taking damage from Dawn's rockfall attack.
Kill the Grotesque Guardians without letting Dawn receive any healing from her orbs.
Kill the Grotesque Guardians without being hit by any lightning attacks.
Kill the Grotesque Guardians before Dusk uses his prison attack for a second time.
Kill the Grotesque Guardians whilst completing the "Don't look at the eclipse", "Prison Break", "Granite Footwork", "Heal no more", "Static Awareness" and "Done before dusk" tasks.
column9: Combat Achievements/Elite;Grotesque Guardians;Don't Look at the Eclipse;Prison Break;Granite Footwork;Heal No More;Static Awareness;Done before Dusk

column6: Kill the Grotesque Guardians 5 times in a row without leaving the instance, whilst completing the Perfect Grotesque Guardians task every time.
column10: The hardest part of this achievement is avoiding the lightning attacks that come after reducing Dusk's health below half. | To avoid the attacks, it is recommended to stay still on a tile and have run turned on, so that one can escape to two tiles away in a single tick if needed. | If the player is using special attacks such as that of the crystal halberd or dragon claws, it is recommended to use these on the final phase of the fight, as not killing Dusk in time will allow him to use a second prison attack. | Being trampled by Dusk does not fail the achievement.

column6: Kill the Grotesque Guardians in less than 2 minutes.
column10: For strategies on this achievement, see Grotesque Guardians Speed-Runner.

column6: Kill the Grotesque Guardians in less than 1:40 minutes.
column10: For strategies on this achievement, see Grotesque Guardians Speed-Runner.

column6: Kill the Grotesque Guardians in less than 1:20 minutes.
column10: Players have two options for this achievement; pure melee, or a melee/ranged hybrid. | As hybrid, players are recommended to bring both the toxic blowpipe with dragon darts and a venator bow with dragon arrows. | At the start of the fight, the player can get 4-6 hits with a blowpipe before needing to swap to the venator bow. | Make sure that Dusk is next to Dawn while hitting the latter so that the bow will bounce twice on her. | For Dusk, a scythe of Vitur is highly recommended due to Dusk's near non-existent Defence, allowing it to hit very hard and frequently. | During phase 3, the player can get 3-4 hits with a blowpipe before needing to switch to the venator bow. | As soon as Dawn reaches 10 or less health, immediately smash her with the rock hammer to save a tick. | During phase 4, the player can save a tick by immediately manually smashing Dusk when his health becomes critical. | The player should dump as many special attacks as possible during this time. | Allowing for the smashing to occur automatically will cause an extra tick or two to pass before the player actually finishes off Dusk, which can be delayed even longer with gear swaps. | The boss kill time is recorded as soon as Dusk dies, not when the drops appear, although the achievement is not marked as complete until they do. | As pure melee, a noxious halberd is mandatory as Dawn can only be hurt with melee weapons classified as polearms. | The polearm can hit even harder than ranged options, and with good luck can easily cause phase transitions in a few hits. | A crystal halberd special attack can be used as a finisher before phase transitions since the 7-tick speed isn't a detriment due to the bosses being immune to damage, but burning claws are recommended to be dumped solely on Dusk because failing to deal sufficient damage or missing will result in more ticks wasted from the crystal halberd's 7-tick speed. | Despite Dusk's immunity to burn damage, his lack of Defence means that every special is likely to hit. | If accuracy is still a problem, players can bring oathplate armour over other armour.

column6: Kill the Grotesque Guardians 10 times without leaving the instance.
column10: This task can be completed with relative ease by bringing 12-14 super restores, a Saradomin godsword, and Guthan the Infested's equipment to serve as food. | While not necessary, an amulet of blood fury can also restore some health while using melee. | Flick Piety and Rigour to conserve prayer points. | The Guardians do not deal a lot of damage through prayer, and any unprotected hits can usually be healed back with the Saradomin godsword or Guthan's equipment. | They can also drop mushroom potatoes and prayer potions to help prolong trips. | Having a lightbearer will double the usage of godsword specials to restore stats. | Without healing equipment you need to minimise damage by avoiding mechanics and off-ticking the Guardians so you can pray against both as described in strategies. | Supply drops are helpful but unreliable; you should use Saradomin brews for healing, so bring an extra Super combat potion and Ranging potion to refresh your divine potion boosts, as well as excess Super restores for prayer restoration and in case the bosses drop brews.

column6: Kill the Grotesque Guardians 20 times without leaving the instance.
column10: Use the following inventory for this task: | Players can swap dragon claws for a saradomin godsword, and the ultor ring for a lightbearer, although these are not necessary unless the player's prayer level is on the lower end. | Flick Piety on every attack and turn protection prayers off during various interludes (such as Dusk's charge attack, lightning phase, final phase transition, etc.) to conserve as many prayer points as possible. | Guthan's sustains better than a saradomin godsword in terms of healing, especially if a lightbearer is not being used. | The boss also drops mushroom potatoes and one or two 4-dose prayer potions at a time, but don't be too reliant on these for the achievement. | Twenty kills, with an average of 1:30, should take around 30-40 minutes, although kills can fluctuate depending on overall dps and how many times Dawn is allowed to heal on the third phase.

column6: Kill a Gargoyle.
Complete the Corrupted Gauntlet 5 times.
Complete the Corrupted Gauntlet 10 times.
Complete the Corrupted Gauntlet 50 times.
Kill the Corrupted Hunllef without taking damage off prayer.
Kill the Corrupted Hunllef without taking damage from: Tornadoes, Damaging Floor or Stomp Attacks. Also, do not take damage off prayer and do not attack the Corrupted Hunllef with the wrong weapon.
Kill the Corrupted Hunllef without making any armour within the Corrupted Gauntlet.
Kill the Corrupted Hunllef without making an egniol potion within the Corrupted Gauntlet.
column9: Combat Achievements/Grandmaster;Corrupted Hunllef;egniol potion;The Corrupted Gauntlet
column10: This achievement can be easily completed by not leaving offensive prayers constantly on during the fight. | Either flick them or do not use them. | It is not necessary to flick defensive prayers. | However, it is required to pray flick the demi-bosses to avoid taking massive and unnecessary damage. | Avoid spending run energy unnecessarily during the preparation phase and fight. | If you have time remaining before entering the central chamber, wait out this time to replenish any missing run energy. | If possible, walk during the first few tornado attacks, as it will be more valuable to have run energy during the later stages of the fight. | As tier 3 armour has the highest prayer bonus, this can be easily done at the same time as Corrupted Warrior, although some care must be taken to conserve stamina for players with lower agility levels.

column6: Kill the Corrupted Hunllef with a full set of perfected corrupted armour equipped.
column9: Bounty Hunter;Combat Achievements/Master;Corrupted Hunllef;perfected corrupted armour
column10: The following materials are required for a full set of perfected armour: | 13 linum tirinum | 13 phren bark | 13 corrupted ores | 650 corrupted shards | An extra 100 shards are needed for two attuned/perfected weapons, 40 shards for two egniol potions, and 40-80 shards for one or two extra teleport crystals. | This makes for a total of 830-870 shards needed. | In order to maximise efficiency during the preparation phase, the player can use the following tactics: | Avoid moving through previously explored rooms. | Do not make two perfected weapons. | Do not collect more than 8 fish. | With a full set of perfected armour, very little food is needed for the fight. | Attack creatures while moving or collecting resources.

column6: Kill the Corrupted Hunllef without making more than one attuned weapon.
column9: Combat Achievements/Grandmaster;Corrupted Hunllef;Attuned crystal equipment;The Corrupted Gauntlet
column10: Despite the achievement's name, the player is not required to attack the Corrupted Hunllef unarmed. | However, if the player is unable to acquire three weapon frames in time, they can make a bow, a staff and punch the Hunllef for the melee hit. | The simplest strategy is to make one perfected and one basic weapon and switch weapons every 6 hits; bring more paddlefish than usual since the fight will take longer. | The achievement can be completed using the 5-1 strategy so that the Corrupted Hunllef never prays against the one perfected weapon the player makes: | During the preparation phase, collect three weapon frames and one component for a perfected weapon. | Make one perfected weapon (preferably one the Corrupted Hunllef did not spawn praying against) and two basic weapons. | Otherwise, prepare normally. | During the fight, strike the Hunllef five times with the perfected weapon and once with the basic weapon it is not praying against. | Repeat this process until the end of the fight. | Example: | The Hunllef spawns praying Protect from Magic; the player makes a perfected halberd, a basic bow and a basic staff. | When the fight starts, the player hits the Hunllef five times with the halberd, then once with the bow, making it switch to Protect from Missiles. | The player hits the Hunllef five times with the halberd, then once with the staff, making it switch to Protect from Magic. | Repeat the previous steps. | If at any point the Hunllef accidentally switches to Protect from Melee, attack it six times with either of the basic weapons.

column6: Complete a Corrupted Gauntlet in less than 7 minutes and 5 seconds.
Complete a Corrupted Gauntlet in less than 6 minutes and 5 seconds.
Complete the Gauntlet 5 times.
Complete the Gauntlet 20 times.
Kill the Crystalline Hunllef without taking damage off prayer.

Kill the Crystalline Hunllef without taking damage from: Tornadoes, Damaging Floor or Stomp Attacks. Also, do not take damage off prayer and do not attack the Crystalline Hunllef with the wrong weapon.
Kill the Crystalline Hunllef without making any armour within the Gauntlet.
Kill the Crystalline Hunllef without making an egniol potion within the Gauntlet.
column10: This combat achievement may be more easily done when attempted alongside the Crystalline Warrior task, due to the Prayer bonus from the tier 3 perfected crystal equipment making prayer flicks less important to perfect while taking less damage. | On the other hand, the resources for tier 3 armour take a long time to gather and may even exhaust your run energy, which cannot be restored with an egniol potion if attempting this task. | For players confident in their prayer flicking, it is recommended to use tier 1 armour for this achievement. | For reference, a player with 70 Prayer and tier 1 armour can keep an overhead protection prayer active for 4 minutes and 12 seconds.

column6: Kill the Crystalline Hunllef with a full set of perfected armour equipped.
column10: The following materials are required for a full set of perfected armour: | 13 linum tirinum | 13 phren bark | 13 crystal ores | 650 crystal shards | An extra 100 shards are needed for two attuned/perfected weapons, 40 shards for two egniol potions, and 40-80 shards for one or two extra teleport crystals. | This makes for a total of 830-870 shards needed. | In order to maximise efficiency during the preparation phase, the player can use the following tactics: | Avoid moving through previously explored rooms. | Do not make two perfected weapons. | Do not collect more than 8 fish. | With a full set of perfected armour, very little food is needed for the fight. | Attack creatures while moving or collecting resources.

column6: Kill the Crystalline Hunllef without making more than one attuned weapon.
column9: Combat Achievements/Elite;Crystalline Hunllef;Attuned crystal equipment;The Gauntlet

column6: Complete the Gauntlet in less than 4 minutes and 45 seconds.
Complete the Gauntlet in less than 3 minutes and 45 seconds.
Kill Glough in less than 2 minutes and 30 seconds.
column10: Before starting the fight, cast vengeance and spellbook swap to the Arceuus spellbook. | When the fight starts, summon a thrall and cast vengeance again. | If you are using defence lowering special attack weapons, dump your special attacks at the start of the fight, if not, reserve some special attack energy for the third phase. | It is not too difficult to quickly chip through the first two phases with regular attacks, vengeance spells and a thrall. | You can disable your prayer after casting vengeance to maximize the recoil damage. | Between phases you can heal up as you have to run to the next room. | In the last phase, use all your special attack energy and cast vengeance when possible. | If you are struggling with melee, consider using a bow of Faerdhinen with crystal armour, or if available, a twisted bow. | Dying in the instance will place the player with all items intact back in Zooknock's house. | Special attack energy does not regenerate if you die, so consider bringing a lightbearer ring to recharge special attack energy between attempts more quickly.

column6: Kill a Greater Demon.
Finish off a Greater Demon with a demonbane weapon.
column10: Any monster that is classified as a greater demon for Slayer tasks may be killed to complete this achievement. | This includes K'ril Tsutsaroth, and his bodyguard Tstanon Karlak, in the God Wars Dungeon, and Skotizo, in the Catacombs of Kourend.

column6: Kill a Hellhound.
Kill Hespori 5 times.
Finish off Hespori with a special attack.
Kill all of Hesporis flowers within 5 seconds.
column10: Players should use throwing knives to complete the achievement, as they have a fast attack speed. | Darts can also be used, but have slightly less range. | Flowers have a 100% chance of being hit and dying, so the type of knives or darts being used do not matter. | Make sure to have the knives/darts set to rapid. | When the fight is beginning, spam-click the first flower. | As soon as the experience drop appears, move on to the next flower. | Players with access to Blisterwood stakes set to rapid can hit all the flowers without needing to move. | Alternatively, a combination of a 4-tick powered staff with a built-in magic spell (e.g., Trident of the Swamp) and fast melee weapon can be used. | Stand next to one flower and attack the other three flowers using the staff in quick succession, then switch to melee for the fourth flower. | If the flowers are not killed in time, exit the room using the entrance or an emergency teleport, and then return. | This will allow for another attempt, instead of killing Hespori and having to grow another one.

column6: Kill Hespori without losing any prayer points.
column10: Players with decent combat stats should be able to kill the Hespori without using Prayer at all. | Extra food may be helpful to make up for this. | Prayer drain from Thralls does NOT count, meaning they can be used to aid in the fight.

column6: Kill the Hespori in less than 48 seconds.
column10: For strategies on this achievement, see Hespori Speed-Chaser.

column6: Kill the Hespori in less than 36 seconds.
Open Obor's chest once.
Open Obor's chest 5 times.
Kill Obor whilst he is immobilized.
column10: To complete this task freeze Obor such as by using Bind, Snare, or Entangle before dealing the last hit of damage. | Having a high Magic level will make this task increasingly easy, as spells such as Ice Burst, Ice Blitz and Ice Barrage will immobilize Obor for several seconds, allowing the final hit to be dealt more easily. | The Zamorak godsword's special attack cannot be used to complete this task.

column6: Kill Obor without being pushed back more than one square by his knockback attack.
column10: If using melee, the player should immediately run to the corner of the room, so Obor cannot push them back any further. | If using magic, freeze Obor in place using snare or similar to prevent him from using his knockback attack.

column6: Kill Obor without taking any damage off prayer.
column10: Using Magic and either Snare or freezing spells is recommended for this achievement. | Use the Protect from Missiles Prayer and avoid melee damage at all costs. | The achievement will still complete if the player takes damage from the falling rocks while praying Protect from Missiles. | Remember to enable Prayers before climbing down to fight Obor. | Enabling Prayers during the climb-down may cause the achievement to fail. | Make sure to enter the room when Obor is far away from the rocks used to enter the lair, to decrease the chance of Obor hitting before he is caught with a Snare or freezing spell. | With a high Magic level, Ice Barrage is recommended. | Players with high melee stats may also choose to try and tank the damage by praying range and equipping good crush armour while trying to end the fight quickly with a high damage spec weapon such as the dragon dagger or dragon claws. | While this method is less skill intensive, it does require an amount of luck to pull off and may take several tries.

column6: Kill Obor on a free to play world.
column10: Bring runes for Earth Blast, and optionally, Snare. | Note that stat boosts from members-only items, such as a super strength potion, will be cancelled by logging into a free to play world.

column6: Kill the Alchemical Hydra 75 times.
Kill the Alchemical Hydra 150 times.
column10: The minimum amount of Hydras that Konar can assign is 125, so a Bracelet of slaughter is helpful to complete this achievement in a single task.

column6: Kill the Alchemical Hydra without being hit by the acid pool attack.

column6: Kill the Alchemical Hydra without being hit by the lightning attack.

column6: Kill the Alchemical Hydra without being hit by the flame wall attack.

column6: Kill the Alchemical Hydra without empowering it.

column6: Kill the Alchemical Hydra without letting it spawn a flame wall attack.
column10: Most players with a twisted bow, dragon hunter lance, or dragon hunter crossbow (with some lucky enchanted bolt effects) will usually complete this achievement at some point during the 150 kill combat task grind, due to high hitting abilities of these weapons. | There are a few methods to maximise damage during this phase: | Vengeance can add up to an additional 52 damage. | Cast Vengeance during the Hydra's green or blue phase, so the cooldown timer can expire and be recast immediately after it procs during red phase. | Lure Hydra onto the blue vent while it is still in blue phase so that it will have its defence reduced as soon as possible after changing to red phase. | Without access to the above listed weapons, a toxic blowpipe with dragon darts is recommended. | Use a crystal halberd special or other high hitting weapon for a final hit just before it reaches the centre of the room. | Optionally, use Spellbook Swap to summon a thrall, which can contribute additional damage, though its impact is negligible. | A Bandos godsword and a Lightbearer can be used to reduce the Hydra's defence to 0 and then regenerate special attack energy before starting the red phase.

column6: Kill the Alchemical Hydra without taking any damage.
column10: All damage from the boss is avoidable; the only issue is the first attack it uses upon entering the boss room, which cannot be predicted. | If it attacks with the opposite style that is prayed against, leave the room and try again.

column6: Kill the Alchemical Hydra using only Dharok's Greataxe as a weapon whilst having no more than 10 Hitpoints throughout the entire fight.
column10: Enter the Alchemical Hydra's chamber praying Protect from Magic, as Dharok's armour has higher ranged defence than magic. | If it attacks with ranged: | Teleport out immediately and try again (requires very quick reactions). | Tick eat the attack with a low-healing food such as purple sweets or cooked meat, which are also useful if you lose track of which attack is coming next. | You still have a chance to block the damage with your melee armour stats. | For the rest of the fight, which is the same as a normal melee fight, see Alchemical Hydra/Strategies. | Due to the low damage per second afforded by Dharok's equipment, it is likely that the player will face multiple special attacks per phase. | This occurs after the ninth regular attack following the first special attack. | Make sure to start moving in advance of the second poison blob attacks during the first and fourth phases. | To always avoid the shotgun poison blot after the 3rd/9th attack, run under and through the hydra. | For the lightning attack, start in the north-east corner when the attack goes out, and run west along the northern wall. | If the lightning lingers upon reaching the western wall, run south along it. | If there is a second round of lightning, do the opposite movement by starting in the north-west corner, run east to the north-eastern corner and if the lightning lingers, run south along the wall. | Thralls can be used to complete this task, meaning it is possible to avoid using the set entirely, though it will be significantly slower if relying only on thralls. | However, inflicting recoil damage with a ring of recoil, ring of suffering, or Vengeance is not allowed.

column10: The hydra's massive health pool and high Magic level make the Twisted bow the optimal weapon to complete the task, and Dragon claws are helpful in bursting down a phase. | With good gear and enough luck, it is possible to complete with dragon hunter lance or even a toxic blowpipe. | To save time: | Lure the hydra to each respective chemical pool as soon as possible, blue and red phases should start with hydra already standing on the respective pools to be de-buffed. | The blue phase should be ended as fast as possible, as getting hit by one of the lightning strikes will bind and damage the player for ~25. | Clearing the fire phase early avoids unnecessary damage to the player and lost time from the knockback. | Avoid attack delays by using Guthix rests throughout the fight. | 80 seconds allows for 4 optimal Vengeance hits, and requires high health at the start of enrage phase: | Vengeance before entering, there's a 50% chance the first attack will be prayed correctly. | If prayed correctly, hold until green phase acid pool removes damage reduction. | Vengeance after first vengeance is consumed, pray correctly to hold and use in blue phase. | Vengeance after second vengeance is consumed in blue phase, pray correctly to hold until enrage phase. | Vengeance after third vengeance is consumed in enrage phase, player will take a second large hit and will need to avoid further damage or risk death.

column6: Complete the Fight caves without letting any of the Yt-MejKot heal.

column6: Complete the Fight Caves without TzTok-Jad being healed by a Yt-HurKot.
column10: In general, this achievement is made easier by luring Jad towards the entrance in the north-east corner of the arena. | The healers are spawned in areas away from the cave's entrance, so luring Jad here can give more time to either deal with Jad, or to tag the healers. | The most common approach is to use a long-range weapon to attack the healers before they reach Jad. | Possible 4-tick weapons with a 10-tile attack range are the Bow of Faerdhinen, crystal bow, or Magic comp bow, set to rapid. | Another, riskier but faster approach is to reduce Jad to just above 150 hitpoints, the point at which healers will spawn, then cast Vengeance and use two dragon claws special attacks in quick succession while allowing Jad to hit the player, which is likely to quickly finish it off before any Yt-HurKots have the chance to heal. | Do not attempt this combat achievement on Rotation 5 (the "speedrun" rotation) without dragging Jad away from his spawn, as a healer spawns directly adjacent to its spawn. | It is advisable to attempt this on Rotation 7, 8 or 11 as Jad spawns in the middle of the cave. | Another approach is to get Jad stuck right next to the rock west of the entrance. | This can be done by first luring Jad to the entrance (using the blue tile marker), and when Jad reaches the red tile marker, running to the cyan tile marker in north-western area of the arena. | Stay still as far north as possible, and wait for Jad to touch the northern wall. | Then in a single run, run towards the grey tile marker on the corner of the rock. | This will cause you to stand in melee distance of Jad's south-western tile. | This south-western tile is the tile the healers will try to walk to when healing Jad, but your presence there will body block the healers. | This way, the healers will be unable to heal Jad, without you needing to tag them and/or deal with their damage. | Note that this strategy requires players to be comfortable with flicking Jad's melee attacks as well as its other two attack styles. | Jad's melee attacks are executed without delay, so Protect from Melee should always be up between attacks. | Furthermore, Jad attacks at a 4-tick interval when using melee, which may require faster reactions on the prayer switches. | However, when correctly switching prayers, this strategy allows players to focus completely on their prayer and prayer potions, without needing to focus on their health.
