column6: Complete the Fight Caves without being attacked by a Tz-Kih.
column10: Tz-Kihs will appear in 32 out of the 63 waves of the Fight Caves. | Tz-Kihs are melee enemies and have near nonexistent stats, so the player should take them out with reasonable ranged weapon, such as a toxic blowpipe or Craw's bow. | The latter is recommended in the event that the blowpipe misses or fails to hit, so the player can maintain distance from the Tz-Kih until it is dead. | Logging out or hopping worlds between waves may cause the achievement not to be awarded.

column6: Complete the Fight Caves with only melee.
column10: Equipping a Ranged weapon, Magic weapon, or salamander will cause the task to fail regardless of whether or not they attack anything with it. | This includes weapons that primarily have melee bonuses, but can also autocast spells, like the Lunar staff and blisterwood flail. | However, manually casting spells with a melee weapon equipped will not fail the task. | This means that casting Vengeance, casting blood spells, or summoning thralls with resurrection spells will not fail the task, as long as a melee weapon is equipped. | Using a halberd (preferably a noxious halberd) can make the challenge easier as it allows players to attack from two tiles away instead of one, preventing rangers and magers from attacking with melee.

column6: Complete the Fight Caves without losing any prayer points.
column10: It is a common myth that 1-tick prayer flicking is required for this task. | Lazy flicking the magers and Jad is enough to clear this task, with some room for mistakes. | Players must avoid all Tz-Kihs; getting hit by one will fail the task whether or not it drains a prayer point, automatically disqualifying the player from the achievement. | The player will need to safespot as many monsters as possible, especially the Ket-Zeks as these can deal massive damage if their attacks are not protected against. | Prayer flicking is still allowed to complete the task. | High prayer bonus gear offers a buffer before a prayer point drain, if prayer is left on beyond the first tick. | Thralls can be summoned without failing the task. | The player can be resurrected via the Karamja Elite Diary reward and still be eligible for the task. | The Falador shield 4 resets the player's internal prayer drain counter, which will clear mistakes from leaving prayer on beyond the first tick. | The shield cannot be used with full prayer points, but this restriction can be circumvented with thrall spells. | Lower tier Falador shields do not work. | The task won't complete if the player hops worlds during the attempt. | However, you can log out and back into the same world without failing the task. | As logging back in the Fight Caves puts the player in the centre of the cave and gives them a few seconds to move before the wave starts, this can be used to safespot Ket-Zeks at the beginning of most waves without penalty. | To pray against the mages, set a 15-tile radius marker on the Ket-Zek (NPC ID 3125+3126), and position yourself outside the range for when they spawn on the next wave. | Let it walk towards you, and enable Protect from Magic the tick you enter the radius. | Continue to prayer flick matching the 4-tick attack cycle. | To prayer flick against Jad, enable the prayer on the 3rd tick of the attack animation, and disable on the 4th tick. | Setting an 8-tick timer can help visualize the timing.

column6: Complete the Fight Caves in less than 30 minutes.
column10: For strategies on this achievement, see Fight Caves Speed-Runner.

column6: Complete the Fight Caves in less than 26 minutes and 30 seconds.
column10: It is highly advised to use rotation 5 if going for this achievement due to it having the best spawns (e.g. wave 62 has both magers spawn close together), although any rotation may be used if learned well enough. | While doing the run itself is relatively simple, there are many minor time saves that should be used throughout: | Drink a dose of stamina potion, divine super combat potion, and divine ranging potion before entering. | The boost from an imbued heart or saturated heart may also be used for slightly longer thralls during the initial waves, although this is optional. | Roughly memorising the spawns of each wave as well as where to stand at the beginning of each wave will help greatly in dealing with every wave properly. | The Fight Caves Spawn Predictor plugin on RuneLite's Plugin Hub is especially helpful, as it has an option to display the next wave's spawns. | Stand in between the spawn point of the high-HP NPCs and the rest of the NPCs (while still being close enough to attack). | When the wave starts, begin attacking and dragging the high-HP NPC towards the weaker NPCs. | Killing the large blobs early in the wave allows you to attack something else while waiting for them to split into the two bloblets. | While attacking a mob, it's possible to dance other mobs inbetween attacks in order to chin them after the mob you are attacking dies. | Always end the wave by killing bats/bloblets, as their death animation is 2 ticks faster than that of the other NPCs, along with the fact that they can be clumped and killed all at the same time with chinchompas. | Safespotting the meleer by using other mobs saves time in not having to run to actual safespots along the edges. | Melee can also be kited by stepping 2 tiles away and using a Toxic blowpipe to maintain a consistent gap. | Use as many claw special attacks on meleers prior to wave 31. | After wave 31, blowpipe special attacks should be used when needed to heal chip damage taken. | You may also claw special attack the one blob on wave 2 and both blobs on wave 6. | They are not needed for the ranger on wave 7, as the blowpipe will kill it quickly regardless. | Death charge is procced on all mobs, and should be constantly used throughout the cave, ideally before speccing (also to shorten cooldown, as that timer starts on cast and not proc), in order to restore spec when the mob dies. | If using spec as soon as bar is up, spamming death charge on cooldown is sufficient. | Mobs die 2 ticks slower if they are moving compared to if they are stationary. | While this seems small, ending every wave by killing moving NPCs results in roughly a minute and 14 seconds of time loss. | This should generally not be a problem when setting up clumps of bats/bloblets to kill with chinchompas, although this should be kept in mind for waves that lack either of those mobs. | Mobs die 1 tick faster if they are hit by multiple hitsplats when dying. | Thralls will help in occasionally achieving this. | Multiple hitsplat weapons such as the Scythe of Vitur and Dual macuahuitl will result in this happening, although the latter has a faster attack speed and will suffice for bats or blobs. | Notable special attacks with this feature are dragon claws and burning claws. | Use as many supplies as you can each attempt - Prayer will not be an issue with this setup. | As the inventory will be filled with super restores, keep Rigour activated throughout the entire run. | Additionally, resummon thralls whenever they are not attacking anything (eg. if they are too far away from any mobs to attack). | A spectating friend can pay attention to buff timers, allowing the player to focus on their movement and clicks. | Note: These potions should be used before entering, then the inventory refilled in the bank. | This gives the benefits of the potions without using extra inventory space. | Ancient mace to go past full prayer points | Prayer regeneration potion for prayer regeneration buff | Stamina potion for run energy conservation buff | Divine combat potion and Divine ranging potion for free potion doses, though these may not be necessary providing you get a good time | Anglerfish to go past max hitpoints, or Saradomin brew (Anglerfish overheals more) | Restore potion to restore stats lost by Forgotten brew and Saradomin brew | (Optional) A Vengeance cast prior to switching to the Arceuus spellbook; or Vengeance other received from a friend. | This is likely not necessary, however, as it will probably only make the difference of a few seconds | (Optional) Summer pie to increase agility level, allowing for better run maintenance. | This effect is small, or even negligible if stamina potions are used.

Kill the Kalphite Queen 50 times.
Kill the Kalphite Queen while her defence was last lowered by you.
column10: This task can most reliably be completed by using a special attack from the bone dagger or crossbow, which are guaranteed to hit if used as the first attack on the Kalphite Queen. | However, the following special attacks all drain defence upon a successful hit and can be used: | Darklight | Arclight | Emberlight | Bandos godsword | Dragon warhammer | Elder maul | Barrelchest anchor | Accursed sceptre | Tonalztics of Ralos | Additionally, successful attacks with the following also drain defence: | Claws of guthix | Any shadow spell with the Shadow ancient sceptre | Curse or Vulnerability | If attacked by the Kalphite Queen, the following items both have a chance to drain defence levels, if Kalphite Queen still has more than half of her health, assuming they are charged: | Black mask | Any weapon while a Broodoo shield (poison) is equipped, and only if damaged by the Kalphite Queen

Kill the Kalphite Queen using only the Verac's Flail as a weapon.
column10: The entire Verac's set is not needed to complete the task, only the flail, though the set effect makes it stronger than some mid and lower level setups even while on task. | If not using the full set, strength bonus and crush attack bonus should be prioritised. | Kalphite tasks can be assigned by any Slayer master other than Krystilia and Mortimer for the Slayer helmet or black mask bonus. | Alternatively, the serpentine helm can be used for its poison chance, allowing you to wait out the poison and avoid taking hits from the Kalphite Queen. | It is also possible to complete this achievement without the use of a Verac's flail at all if A Kingdom Divided has been completed. | The task will complete if the Kalphite Queen is killed using only magic thralls. | However, after 12 game ticks, the thrall will lose focus on your target so you need to be hitting the Kalphite Queen every 12 game ticks. | The best way to do this is with a melee setup with -64 Crush Accuracy, which guarantees that every melee attack will miss. | This is easily achieved with a cursed goblin hammer as it has -100 crush accuracy. | By combining this with a flinching setup described on the strategies page one can take almost no damage completing this. | Let the thrall do four attacks before stepping out to do a non-damaging flinch, step back under and repeat until dead. | Splashing with a range or mage setup will also work. | If not flinching then stepping under the Kalphite Queen between attacks will help to reduce the total damage taken while attempting the kill. | For accounts with one Defence, bringing an alt account with the Heal Other spell and the flail to kill the first form can make it a singular trip.

column6: Kill the Kraken 50 times in a private instance without leaving the room.
column10: The combat achievement is only possible on a cave kraken or Kraken boss Slayer assignment of at least 50 kills. | Players should bring a full inventory of high healing food and their best magic defence equipment. | A trident of the seas or swamp should be enough to complete the achievement on its own, but additional blood spells can help recover hitpoints in a pinch. | It is possible to use blood spells on the whirlpool to heal in between kills without being attacked, and can be utilised as many times as desired between kills. | Note: While the Kraken can drop cooked sharks when killed, the drop rate for them may not be enough to sustain the given kill count. | The achievement is possible with good food and enough shark drops from it, but blood spells provide much more reliable healing. | It will take roughly one hour to complete the achievement with decent gear and by casting blood spells on the whirlpool.

column6: Kill the Kraken 100 times in a private instance without leaving the room.
column10: Due to the fact that the Kraken can only be fought on task, the combat achievement requires getting a task from either Nieve, Steve, Duradel, or Kuradal for a guaranteed task of at least 100 kills. | Konar quo Maten can also give the required amount as her maximum amount. | Using the Krack on Slayer task extension will additionally allow both Konar and Chaeldar to be guaranteed to assign the required amount. | Bracelets of slaughter can also be used to increase the effective amount of shorter tasks. | It is recommended to bring runes for blood spells as a means of healing as the Kraken's supply drops are not reliable enough to obtain the achievement. | Blood spells can be cast on the Kraken while it is submerged without waking it for infinite healing between kills. | A Sanguinesti staff will help during kills, or another weapon that can auto-cast ancient magic is beneficial such as the Ancient staff to avoid the need to manually cast repeatedly. | If using blood spells, it could be beneficial to bring an Explorer's ring to cast high/low alchemy. | Equipping a Rondache in the offhand will trivialise this task, as its +2 flat armour completely negates the damage from the tentacles in the room. | Players may still find it helpful to bring an infinite source of healing with the Rondache. | While the Kraken's shark drops may not be enough to sustain the kill count, they may still be kept for later in case players take large amounts of damage (albeit very unlikely) while still fighting. | To avoid potential death, players need to have at least 30 hitpoints for taking a max hit from the Kraken on top of damage from each tentacle. | If using a trident of the seas, approximately 1400 charges are used. | You can bring extra fire runes to recharge your trident during the trip, as Kraken drops Coins, Chaos and Death runes. | Note - the instance closes when you log out, so all the kills need to be done in the one login session. | Due to this, it is also important to be wary of the 6 hour logout timer if you have been playing for a long time already, as the task itself can be fairly long. (The timer can be reset by logging out and logging back in before entering the cave). | It can take roughly two hours to complete the achievement assuming decent gear and blood spells are being used between kills.

column10: After reaching half health (100 HP), each attack the Giant Mole takes may prompt her to dig away to another location in her lair. | Circumvent this by using Dharok the Wretched's equipment while staying at low health. | Additionally, by using a superpoisoned weapon, the poison will deal enough damage to kill the mole without her burrowing, provided the final attack reduces her health below 100. | Regular weapon poison is a poor choice for this technique, as it only does 50 damage in total before expiring, and considering that even successful melee hits only have a 25% chance of poisoning, it will be unlikely that the player can poison the mole again before she burrows several times. | For Ironmen, who typically do not have access to weapon poison(++) due to the high Herblore level requirement, a great alternative is completing the Tai Bwo Wannai Trio quest and speaking to Tamayu, who will reward the player with a rune spear(kp). | This karambwan-poison-coated weapon has the same poison strength as weapon poison(++).

column9: Moons of Peril;High Hitter;Combat Achievements/Elite;Giant Mole
column10: Misses (0 hitsplat) do not count towards the 4 or less hits. | The giant mole has 200 Hitpoints, so each hit must deal an average of 50 damage to complete the task. | The easiest method is to use Dharok the Wretched's equipment with 1 Hitpoints, a higher Hitpoints level will increase damage, and the highest melee strength items possible — an amulet of rancour, amulet of torture, or amulet of strength, Avernic treads (max) (dragon boots are acceptable), a fire cape/infernal cape or equivalents and barrows/ferocious gloves to hit as hard as possible. | The Soulreaper axe will also provide similar possible outcome. | Use the aggressive hack-slash combat option on the Dharok's greataxe against the mole's slightly lower slash Defence compared to crush Defence. | Without access to Dharok's, another option is to use a high hitting special attack weapon with a single hitsplat (Armadyl godsword, Bandos godsword, dragon warhammer, Voidwaker etc.) and teleporting to a player-owned house to recharge special attack energy so that the only 4 hits on the boss are special attacks. | If the first 2 hits are not high enough, either kill the boss normally or hop worlds to reset the task. | Note that hitting 0 damage on the boss does not count as a hit for the purposes of this task, so if one of the attacks missed, the task can still be completed by going to a house for special attack energy and then speccing again. | Another option is to use a poison weapon since poison splat damage does not count towards the 4 hits. | For this method, serpentine helm with toxic blowpipe, trident of the swamp, or toxic staff of the dead works best to guarantee a poison hit. | For this method, disable auto retaliate, attack the Giant Mole so there is at least a hit higher than 0, wait until the poison hit goes down to 1, and attack the mole again. | Dragon dagger (p++), abyssal dagger (p++), or any other poisoned weapon also work; however, there is no guarantee that the Giant Mole will be poisoned on the first hit. | Emerald bolts (e) are especially useful for this task, as they have a 55% chance to poison (compared to 25% for melee poisoned weapons and 12.5% chance for ranged poisoned weapons). | Speccing the Giant Mole twice with Bandos godsword or dragon warhammer first, then following up with 2 hits with poison weapon (after waiting for the poison damage to go down to 1) could speed up this process as well. | Note: if you have failure notifications turned on, you will get a message on the fourth hit that you have failed the task. | If the Giant Mole dies from poison damage after this, you will still complete the task. | Alternatively a player can use the Arkan Blade special attack. | This weapon regularly hits over 50 damage per special attack, teleporting out of the mole's lair to restore special attack energy does not fail this achievement. | Damage from a Thrall counts towards the 4 hits and therefore they shouldn't be used.

column6: Kill the Giant Mole without her damaging anyone.
column10: The Giant Mole only attacks with melee. | If melee is being used against the Giant Mole, Protect from Melee can be activated to negate all damage. | Otherwise, Ranged or Magic can be used while using Protect from Melee, or while safespotting the Giant Mole on corners of the wall in the Mole Hole.

column10: Parasites only appear in phase 2, so clearing it quickly will prevent too many of them from spawning, though the phase itself can take quite a while due to the Nightmare's durable shield and totems. | The parasite will burst from the player in 4-5 of their attacks (depending on weapon used), so it is recommended to walk underneath the Nightmare so that the parasite will not be able to heal her right away. | Drinking Relicym's balm or Sanfew serum is required before the parasite spawns as it will reduce their combat stats significantly, making them easier to kill. | The parasite will have 40 health. | Several alternative methods may be more efficient, such as stepping under the parasites and attacking with the dragon claws or crimson kisten special attack, since unlike its hard mode variant, weapons on crush will not max hit the parasite. | Additional options for dealing high damage per second include the following weapons and their respective special attacks: | Elder maul | Granite maul | Dragon dagger(p++) | Dragon mace | Voidwaker

column6: Kill two Husks at the same time.
column10: A dragon 2h sword or Dinh's bulwark special attack or a standard attack from Hallowfell, when targeted on the Nightmare, should kill both husks immediately. | Husks have 20 hitpoints. | Barrage spells or chinchompas can also work if the player doesn't have access to either weapon, though the husks are much more resistant to both styles. | As a last resort for Ironmen, the husks can be weakened, then finished off with the special attack from a Rune thrownaxe, though this method is much less consistent and may take multiple attempts. | Using the prayer Retribution also triggers completion, if you weaken the husks beforehand. | Note: Even though Husks also appear in Phosani's Nightmare, this achievement is only completable in Phase 1 of The Nightmare.

column6: Kill the Nightmare without any player taking damage from the following attacks: Nightmare rifts, an un-cured parasite explosion, Corpse flowers or the Nightmare's Surge. Also, no player can take damage off prayer or have their attacks slowed by the Nightmare spores.
Kill the Nightmare solo.
column9: Combat Achievements/Elite;the Nightmare;amulet of blood fury

column6: Kill the Nightmare without any player losing any prayer points.
column10: Prayer flicking is recommended to speed up the kill and take minimal damage as the Nightmare's attacks will deal higher damage if not prayed against. | While completable solo, it is recommended to attempt the achievement in groups as they result in a faster kill. | It is not recommended to flick stat-boosting prayers alongside protection prayers, as they generally have a higher drain rate compared to protection prayers and a single mistake will disqualify the entire team from the achievement. | Lastly, summoning thralls (which drains prayer points) will not disqualify players.

column6: Defeat the Nightmare (Solo) in less than 23 minutes.
column10: For strategies on this achievement, see Nightmare (Solo) Speed-Runner.

column6: Defeat the Nightmare (Solo) in less than 19 minutes.
column10: For strategies on this achievement, see Nightmare (Solo) Speed-Runner.

column6: Defeat the Nightmare (Solo) in less than 16 minutes.
column10: A Scythe of Vitur is the most powerful weapon for this task, but an Inquisitor's mace or Soulreaper axe are viable alternatives. | The relatively low Defence and high Hitpoints of the boss make those weapons' extra accuracy less valuable than the scythe's increased amount of hits, but either weapon is still sufficient for an experienced player. | Eye of Ayak and ancestral robes are beneficial for inflicting extra damage to the totems, with Tumeken's shadow and Sanguinesti staff trailing close behind in DPS. | The Arceuus spellbook's ghostly thralls deal double damage on the totems, and Death Charge can be used on husks, parasites, and sleepwalkers to restore special attack more frequently. | Use Crimson kisten or Voidwaker specials against the Nightmare. | Lightbearer is very useful for spec regeneration.

column6: Defeat the Nightmare (5-scale) in less than 5 minutes.
Defeat the Nightmare (5-scale) in less than 4 minutes.
Defeat the Nightmare (5-scale) in less than 3:30 minutes.

Kill Dagannoth Prime 25 times.
Kill Dagannoth Prime whilst under attack by Dagannoth Supreme and Dagannoth Rex.
Kill Prime using a Rune Thrownaxe special attack, bounced off Dagannoth Rex.

column6: Kill Dagannoth Rex 10 times.
Kill Dagannoth Rex 25 times.
Kill Dagannoth Rex whilst under attack by Dagannoth Supreme and Dagannoth Prime.
Kill Dagannoth Rex whilst he is immobilized.
Kill Dagannoth Rex and one other Dagannoth king at the exact same time.
column10: The easiest method is to bring another player and attack Dagannoth Rex and a different king on the same tick, causing both to be dealt the killing blow at the same time. | To make this even easier, the Voidwaker's special attack is guaranteed to deal at least 50% of the player's normal max hit, meaning using the special attack at the same time as the other player uses it will not leave your final hits up to chance. | For Ironmen and players who wish to complete the task solo, stack Dagannoth Rex and Dagannoth Prime on top of each other and kill them with the dragon crossbow's special attack. | Alternatively, black chinchompas thrown at Dagannoth Prime have a similar, but slightly weaker effect. | It's recommended to bring both in case the special attack misses. | To ensure the best chance of this method working, bring runes for Entangle to keep Rex as close to death as possible, as it can only hit up to 5 damage. | In either case, ensure neither of the two kings move when lowering their hitpoints to 0, as this will cause their death animations to desync and will not grant the achievement. | Ensure you have kill credit on both Rex and the second Dagannoth king for the combat achievement to count.

column6: Kill Sarachnis 10 times.
Kill Sarachnis 25 times.
Kill Sarachnis without her using her range attack twice in a row.
column10: This achievement is most easily done with melee in a solo encounter as this makes Sarachnis' attacks very predictable. | To avoid damage from her, players should stand in the centre of the room as she spawns (see image), activate Protect from Melee, and wait for her sticky web attack. | Aranea boots will easily allow the player to remain in melee distance, preventing any ranged attacks from occurring. | Otherwise, standing in the area marked in the image will ensure players will only get hit once by her Ranged attack after her web attack, as players will be able to move within range of her melee attack from anywhere in the marked area. | If done correctly, she should never be able to damage players off prayer, and should allow players to complete the Inspect Repellent achievement as well, if they haven't already completed it.

column6: Kill Sarachnis without her dealing damage to anyone.
column10: This achievement is most easily done with melee in a solo encounter, as this makes Sarachnis' attacks very predictable. | To avoid damage from her, the player should stand in the centre of the room as she spawns, activate protect from melee, and wait for her sticky web attack. | Once she says "Hsss!", the player should change to protect from missiles and start spam clicking her, and as soon as the player starts moving, change prayer back to protect from melee. | If done correctly, she should only use her ranged attack once per web and complete the Ready to Pounce achievement as well. | Alternatively, the achievement can be completed by standing in the centre of the room using a halberd and praying protect from missiles. | With running turned off, the player will not accidentally get within Sarachnis' melee range and can thus defeat her without ever switching prayers. | The Aranea boots are invaluable for this achievement. | Players with access to the boots will bypass Sarachnis' sticky web every time and will only need to stay within melee range with protect from melee and running on. | This method in a solo encounter is by far the easiest way to complete the achievement. | Taking damage from her spawns will not fail this achievement.

column6: Kill Sarachnis with a crush weapon.
column10: Other weapons and combat styles can be used during the fight. | Only the final blow has to be dealt using the crush attack style.

column6: Kill Commander Zilyana 50 times.
Kill Commander Zilyana 100 times.
Finish off Commander Zilyana while all of her bodyguards are dead.
column10: A good method to complete this task solo, alongside the similar tasks for each of the respective God Wars Dungeon bosses, is to use a Toxic blowpipe alongside a Serpentine helm to envenom the bodyguards between kills, so that when the boss is low on health all of the minions are also low/dead, allowing them to be killed easier.

column6: Kill Commander Zilyana in a private instance without taking any damage from the boss or bodyguards.
column10: This achievement is fairly straightforward to achieve with the kiting method. | A twisted bow or tumeken's shadow is encouraged to help speed up kills and reduce the amount of time needed to kill Zilyana. | The kiting method will ensure that Starlight, the melee bodyguard, should never hit the player. | This leaves Growler and Bree, the magic and ranged bodyguards respectively, as the only major threat. | It is important to have the two hit on different ticks so their attacks can be protected against. | With some luck, it is possible to kill Zilyana before the bodyguard the player is not protecting against damages the player. | An alternative method to consider is killing either Growler or Bree just after Zilyana respawns, praying protection for the magic/ranged bodyguard that does respawn, then proceeding with the kiting method as normal. | This allows time to kill Zilyana for this Combat Achievement without needing to change prayers.

column6: Kill Commander Zilyana in a private instance without attacking her directly.
column10: The inefficient nature of this achievement encourages setting up for a single kill run. | Using chinchompas to hit Starlight (or other minions) is the fastest method, bypassing Zilyana's high defence via splash damage. | The venator bow is a slower method, but can be used similarly on a minion near Zilyana to complete the achievement. | Barrage spells can also be used, but are the most inefficient method due to Zilyana's high Magic level. | To avoid accidentally attacking Zilyana, use menu entry swapper to change Zilyana's default click option. | Rings of recoil or the ring of suffering will not fail the task, and can be used for additional damage during the kill.

column6: Kill Commander Zilyana in a private instance with melee only.
column10: The achievement is made much easier by running away from (or walking under) Zilyana after every hit, as her magic attack leaves her unable to move for a few seconds, allowing players to trade hits one-for-one despite her fast attack speed. | Use Protect from Magic and an accurate melee weapon like Osmumten's fang, along with a defence-reducing special weapon, such as the elder maul or dragon warhammer. | Ideally, Justiciar armour along with a spectral or elysian spirit shield should be used to greatly reduce damage taken from Zilyana's attacks. | Note: A ring of recoil, Vengeance, and other forms of damage reflection will fail this task. | However, zombified thralls are allowed as they use melee. | The Voidwaker's special attack will also cause the task to fail, as it is magic based.

column6: Kill Commander Zilyana 50 times in a privately rented instance without leaving the room.
column10: Follow the typical strategies for fighting Zilyana in a solo encounter. | Drops in a private instance (barring bones) will remain for 3 hours, more than enough for the achievement. | This task is significantly longer than any other God Wars kill count task, as Zilyana respawns 90 seconds after being killed. | With 50 kills being required for the task, the spawn time alone will account for 73.5 minutes, and kill times can be fairly inconsistent, so players should expect to be staying for a minimum of at least two hours for the task. | Due to this, it is highly recommended to use the bathroom before attempting the task and to avoid drinking too many fluids. | If a bathroom break is necessary, it should be done during minion cleanup, autocasting Blood Barrage on minions to sustain health. | Be sure to re-log/world hop before starting the attempt, in order to avoid potentially being six hour logged midway through the attempt. | It is also imperative that the player take care of their physical well being, such as through regular stretches, particularly during the respawn phase after having dealt with the minions which allows for downtime. | Ensure to take a reasonable break in between attempts instead of retrying immediately. | Turning on a secondary light source can help prevent eye strain if playing at night, as can lowering the in-game brightness seting and/or the brightness of the screen due to the bright nature of the God Wars Dungeon. | Be sure to have a source of water on hand and to take regular sips throughout the attempt. | Opening a window beforehand can help prevent headaches. | Getting a Zilyana boss task will help shorten the achievement duration due to the bonuses provided from a slayer helmet. | Players can choose between magic or ranged. | Magic is highly recommended over range for the following reasons: | Best-in-slot magic is more accurate than ranged and less heavy despite losing out on max hits and defence bonuses | Greater healing capability (Blood Barrage on two or even all three minions compared to toxic blowpipe and bones to peaches tabs) | Plenty of inventory spaces saved by not having to bring numerous divine bastion potions due to the saturated heart | Following run energy changes on 8 January 2025, players with 77+ Agility are unlikely to run out of sufficient run energy while killing Zilyana. | Through use of certain methods, players can sustain run energy without using stamina potions. | If run energy is still a problem, a single 4-dose Extended stamina potion should suffice. | Purple sweets can also be used but are much more expensive. | Furthermore, a Summer pie restores 10 run energy per slice and can be obtained as a drop during the attempt. | Prayer regeneration potions are also useful in restoring some prayer over time, and players should bring at least three of these to supplement their own prayer potions and pre-pot one before starting a trip. | Zilyana can drop three sets of four dose prayer potions or super restores. | These are a nice bonus to help sustain trips but should not be fully relied on due to their uncommon drop rate. | If using ranged, players will want to bring at least six divine bastion potions, a toxic blowpipe with dragon darts, a rune pouch for Death Charge and a Lightbearer, as Zilyana does not drop ranging potions and healing is more limited.

column6: Kill Scorpia 10 times.
Kill Scorpia 25 times.
Kill Scorpia without taking any damage from her.
Kill Scorpia without killing her guardians.
column10: Scorpia's guardians will despawn when they have not healed Scorpia for 15 seconds and will not respawn for the rest of the fight. | When the guardians spawn, cast either entangle, ice blitz, or ice barrage on both of them and then lure Scorpia to the other side of the room. | If Scorpia is lured far enough, the guardians will despawn before reaching her. | Blighted entangle sacks or blighted ancient ice sacks are cheap and convenient to use for this purpose.

column6: Kill The Fragment of Seren in less than 4 minutes.
column9: Combat Achievements/Elite;Fragment of Seren;Song of the Elves
column10: Generally, hard foods such as fish or hunter meat should be avoided as the tick delay will consume a significant amount of time while recovering from Seren's special attacks. | Saradomin brews could be used, however these drain stats and are not recommended. | The key to this achievement is to maximise one’s Magic attack damage and bonus, as well as minimising disruption to attacking the Fragment, mainly eating. | Players should also be able to quickly identify the real Fragment when she duplicates herself (being the lighter coloured shadow) as well as bringing a fast weapon, such as darts or blowpipe, to quickly dispose of the crystal whirlwinds to stop her from healing and also to resume attacking her. | An accursed sceptre special attack at the beginning of each phase will reduce her defence and help speed up the kill. | The Eye of Ayak is the best weapon to use due to its fast attack speed, which is affected less by the damage cap of 24 on the Fragment. | The Sanguinesti staff is also a useful staff to gain health back after the max-hitting final special attack. | Players should also bring phoenix necklaces alongside a few divine potions or Zamorak brews, as well as Guthix rests. | When the Fragment uses the high damage attack, the player can manipulate the passive effect of the phoenix necklace to heal the player and provide immunity from the high hitting attack. | The consumables brought should minimise the delay between attacking the Fragment. | In general, when praying against the fragment's attacks, using the above strategy should not be needed when relying on a combination of snowy knights and Guthix rest(4) in the inventory, combined with some Phoenix necklaces and occasional Sanguinesti staff or Blood Barrage healing. | Snowy knights heal for 15 hitpoints per use, while Guthix Rest heals for 5 health per use, for a total of 20 health. | Melee with a multi-hitting weapon (such as the Scythe of Vitur), alongside a defence-draining special attack weapon, is a reliable strategy to complete this task. | This is because the Fragment of Seren's damage cap of 24 applies for each hitsplat rather than overall hits, allowing players to deal more than 24 damage if using multi-hit weapons. | Since she is not immune to burn, the burning claws are also a good option for special attacks. | Do note that, other than the Scythe and your special attack weapons, no melee weapon comes close to the required dps compared to using a modest magic setup and a trident of the seas. | This is partly because she is out of melee range during her 4th special attack. | Pre-pot an anglerfish and a dose of super combat potion prior to attempting the fight, then attempt to drain her defence. | Note that while her defence cannot be lowered below 60, defence drains apply prior to the damage cap. | As such, a hit of 42 from a Bandos godsword will reduce her defence to the lowest possible even if the player appears to hit 22-24. | This allows the usage of another special attacking weapon (such as a dragon dagger or dragon claws) to help speed up the fight. | If the defence reducing attacks don't hit, die and restart. | If the special attacks do hit, attack the Fragment for the remainder of the fight, taking care to step back after each hit to avoid her multi-hit melee attack.

column5: A Frozen Foe from the Past
column6: Kill a Skeletal Wyvern
Kill Zulrah 25 times.
Kill Zulrah 75 times.
Kill Zulrah 150 times.
Kill Zulrah by using the Vengeance spell as the finishing blow.
column10: Keep in mind that Vengeance has a 30 second cooldown, so plan accordingly. | Make sure there are no snakelings present when setting up the kill, otherwise they might hit the player and waste the cast. | Once Zulrah is at less than ~15 HP, cast vengeance before an attack hits. | To help guarantee damage, the player can intentionally get hit by the tail whip attack during Zulrah's magma form, but must ensure that they are positioned away from any pillars as said pillars will cause the attack to miss. | It is possible to use a ring of recoil or a ring of suffering (r) to help as well. | The player does not need to survive Zulrah's final attack in order to obtain the achievement.

column6: Kill 3 Snakelings simultaneously.
column10: Zulrah will usually summon three to four snakelings at a time. | The snakelings may either attack with melee or magic, so lure melee-using snakelings near magic ones and hit the pile with an instant damage area of effect attack, such as throwing a chinchompa, casting a burst/barrage spell, or attacking with Hallowfell. | Toggle recoil off to avoid killing a snakeling, and try to pile them as quickly as possible as they will die off if left too long, even if in combat with the player. | Alternatively, this achievement can also be passively accomplished with your recoil ring eventually whilst fighting Zulrah. | Be mindful not to accidentally die when you are unprepared to receive the achievement notification.

column6: Kill Zulrah whilst taking no damage from the following: Snakelings, Venom Clouds, Zulrah's Green or Crimson phase.
column10: To kill Zulrah without being hit, snakelings need to be killed as quickly as possible. | They spawn as either melee or magic users, their high accuracy means that they are likely to hit if their attack is not protected against. | Ensure distance is kept, pray Protect from Magic, and use a blowpipe to kill the snakelings as they spawn; their NPC IDs are different (with 2045 being the melee spawns, and 2046 being the magic spawns) so you can highlight them for quick differentiation. | Strong defensive (ranged) gear and a defensive prayer will minimise chances of being hit off prayer. | One or two well-timed Chinchompas can also take out a snakeling clump and allow the player to quickly continue killing the boss. | In general, killing the boss as quickly as possible reduces your chance of being hit by a snakeling, so following advice for achieving record times will maximize chances of completing this task. | If resetting to complete this task by itself, players may find the green/ranged rotation to be beneficial to prioritise, as the snakelings spawn almost all together at the start of the kill, and many can be trapped on the far side of the shrine and killed safely from a distance.

column6: Kill Zulrah in less than 1 minute 20 seconds, without a slayer task.
column10: For strategies on this achievement, see Zulrah Speed-Runner.

column6: Kill Zulrah in less than 1 minute, without a slayer task.
column10: For strategies on this achievement, see Zulrah Speed-Runner.

column6: Kill Zulrah in less than 54 seconds, without a slayer task.
column10: As a fast speed-kill achievement, the player will want to use thralls, and all damage-boosting equipment and prayers available for both ranged and magic. | Any hits that would deal over 50 damage to Zulrah will be reduced to 45-50 damage; however, this only applies to individual hitsplats, meaning a special attack from a weapon such as the crystal halberd will work around this damage cap. | Tumeken's shadow is recommended for Zulrah's ranged and melee forms (as the player will be very accurate despite the high Magic level, due to no Magic defence); for the mage form, a toxic blowpipe with dragon darts is recommended for rapid hits, in part due to the faster attack speed and Zulrah's damage cap. | Vengeance can also be useful in rebounding damage back at Zulrah, provided that no Snakelings are present in the arena. | As a finisher, the player can use a dark bow with dragon arrows, to expend special attack energy. | Alternatively, Oathplate armour in conjunction with a Noxious halberd and a Crystal halberd for special attacks may be used, as Zulrah possesses no additional melee defence. | Furthermore an Eclipse atlatl can be brought to attack Zulrah for when Venom Clouds hinder you from getting close to Zulrah. | Players may cast Vengeance on themselves before the fight begins, then use Spellbook Swap to switch to the Arceuus spellbook to summon a thrall. | At level 99 Magic, the thrall will last for the entire fight. | Players may then use Vengeance whenever available to maximize reflected damage.

column6: Kill Dagannoth Supreme 10 times.
Kill Dagannoth Supreme 25 times.
Kill Dagannoth Supreme whilst under attack by Dagannoth Prime and Dagannoth Rex.
Kill all three Dagannoth Kings within 9 seconds of the first one.
Complete the Theatre of Blood 25 times.
column9: Combat Achievements/Elite;Theatre of Blood;Theatre of Blood/Hard Mode

column6: Complete the Theatre of Blood 75 times.
column9: Combat Achievements/Master;Theatre of Blood;Theatre of Blood/Hard Mode

column6: Complete the Theatre of Blood 150 times.
Kill the Pestilent Bloat before he shuts down for the third time.
column10: This achievement is very easy to accomplish as long as players are using the best strength gear they can afford, or elite void. | Ideally some players should have the Scythe of Vitur, though players should have at least a crystal halberd, dragon claws, and a salve amulet (e) since the Bloat is susceptible to the amulet's effects.

column6: Kill Verzik without any Nylocas being frozen and without anyone taking damage from the Nylocas.
column10: This is best completed in a duo or trio encounter, to limit the amount of nylocas that spawns during the fight. | Nylocas Ischyros should be dealt with using a halberd, as it can potentially kill it without being in range for it to explode. | Nylocas Toxobolos and Nylocas Hagios can be killed from a distance with any weapon. | Alternatively, the player can simply avoid them by being at least four tiles away when they explode. | However, this requires a bit more skill to pull off, since the AoE can be large enough to cause collateral to other players if improperly dodged.

column6: Kill Sotetseg after surviving at least 3 ball attacks without sharing the damage and without anyone dying throughout the fight.
column10: The large red ball attack deals 121 damage if the damage is not shared, and is launched after every 10 direct magic attacks Sotetseg makes on the team. | Simply tank the damage via tick-eating, though players should be wary of incoming projectiles to avoid being killed in the process.

column6: Complete the Theatre of Blood without anyone dying through any means and whilst everyone in the team completes the following Combat Achievement tasks in a single run: "Perfect Maiden", "Perfect Bloat", "Perfect Nylocas", "Perfect Sotetseg", "Perfect Xarpus" and "Perfect Verzik".
column9: Combat Achievements/Grandmaster;Perfect Maiden;Perfect Bloat;Perfect Nylocas;Perfect Sotetseg;Perfect Xarpus;Perfect Verzik
column10: Perfect Theatre is considered one of the hardest grandmaster achievements in-game, as the task itself requires that all players complete their master variants at the same time. | Even one simple mistake on any of these tasks will immediately disqualify the whole team, thus all players should have sufficient experience and know how to kill the bosses. | It is best to attempt this achievement in a trio scale, as it means less potential to make overall mistakes (as each additional player can potentially compound a mistake and thus disqualify the entire team), though this does mean the nylocas waves may be more tedious with a lack of chinchompas and barrage spells. | More in-depth advice on every relevant boss can be found under their own respective perfect pages, as listed above.

column6: Kill The Maiden of Sugadinti without anyone in the team taking damage from the following sources: Blood Spawn projectiles and Blood Spawn trails. Also, without taking damage off prayer and without letting any of the Nylocas Matomenos heal The Maiden.
column9: Combat Achievements/Master;The Maiden of Sugadinti;Blood spawn;Nylocas Matomenos
column10: Standing far away from the Maiden (or being able to predict when the blood splatter is launched) will prevent players from being damaged by the attack and minimise the chances of a blood spawn appearing. | As the Maiden only attacks with magic, keeping Protect from Magic on will ensure that no off-prayer hits are received based on her aggro mechanics. | Groups of Nylocas Matamenos will appear when the Maiden reaches 70, 50, and 30% of her health for the first time. | Using common freezing tactics for lone and bunched nylocas will help ensure that they can be bound and killed before they reach the Maiden. | At the 30% interval, it is possible to skip killing them with very good DPS but should not be relied on.

column6: Kill the Pestilent Bloat without anyone in the team taking damage from the following sources: Pestilent flies, Falling body parts or The Pestilent Bloats stomp attack.
column10: Players should avoid immediately entering the arena if Bloat starts by moving north, as they will be flied upon entering the room. | Players entering the room later should also wait until Bloat goes down the first time as he may occasionally send a fly from the far side due to line of sight.

column6: Kill the Nylocas Vasilias without anyone in the team attacking any Nylocas with the wrong attack style, without letting a pillar collapse and without getting hit by any of the Nylocas Vasilias attacks whilst off prayer.
column10: Using barrage spells or chinchompas is not recommended, so players will have to ensure they kill nylos quick enough that pillar health will not be a concern. | Highlighting each nylo before you attack can help avoid accidental misclicks or a nylocas changing styles.

column6: Kill Sotetseg without anyone in the team stepping on the wrong tile in the maze, without getting hit by the tornado and without taking any damage from Sotetseg's attacks whilst off prayer.
column10: The achievement requires players to avoid damage from wrong tiles during the maze mechanic and from Sotetseg's auto-attacks. | Sotetseg will attack with all three combat styles, but with either melee or magic as a primary attack style. | The magic attack will shatter into either another magic attack or a ranged one. | If players are out of melee distance, Sotetseg will only use magic attacks. | The melee attack will tend to hit before a ranged or magic hit, but because of its unpredictability, players can alternatively use a halberd or ranged weapons instead and attack from a distance, ensuring that the melee attacks are never used. | The charged ball can be shared or tick-eaten, but players can skip the attack by triggering the maze at 66% and 33% hp instead. | Wait at around 70% and 40% hp until the ball is sent, then do enough damage to reach the threshold. | Make sure to Protect from Melee when exiting the maze to avoid accidentally taking a hit off prayer if selected by Sotetseg to enter the Shadow Realm.

column6: Kill Xarpus without anyone in the team taking any damage from Xarpus' attacks and without letting an exhumed heal Xarpus more than twice.
column10: Learning how to handle exhumed is the only major roadblock in this achievement, as they are the only major issue due to how they spawn around Xarpus. | It is recommended to try this in a trio encounter, as the exhumed will spawn significantly faster in 4 and 5-man encounters. | Landing defence draining specials from the bandos godsword and dragon warhammer are essential to completing the task. | Players should ideally start together in one corner in a death-dot to minimise the amount of poison splatters across the arena. | Each poison splatter has a 3x3 AoE, so it is important to stand two tiles away from the impact zone to avoid taking damage from it. | Once Xarpus is lowered to 25.0% of its health, it will screech and begin the next phase. | It is important to watch where Xarpus is focusing at to avoid taking damage, after which the team should move to where he had just looked at as Xarpus can never look at the same direction twice in a row. | Assuming that the players were ranging, they should not have any issue with any ragged tiles near him.

column6: Defeat Verzik Vitur without anyone in the team taking damage from Verzik Vitur's attacks other than her spider form's correctly prayed against regular magical and ranged attacks.
column10: No special considerations are needed for this phase as long as teams use enough Dawnbringer special attacks. | Players who seek to deal extra damage with melee should be mindful of Verzik's attack speed and time to hide to avoid getting clipped by her attack. | Make sure to avoid standing next to a pillar once the phase ends to avoid getting hit as it collapses. | To reduce the chance of a nylocas exploding on a player, wait until nylos spawn and freeze them immediately. | The Nylocas Athanatos that spawns will begin to slowly heal Verzik. | As long as it is left alive no more nylocas will spawn and it is very easy to out-damage the healing with a Scythe of Vitur. | Once the Nylocas Matomenos spawn, the purple nylocas can be killed off. | Save any special attacks for Phase 3 enrage. | It is very important to time attacks so that Verzik does not bounce a player, as it is possible to take damage (and fail the achievement) from it, and it is more than likely to be hit by a ranged attack while stunned. | Whoever is tanking Verzik should not step under the boss as it reduces the travel time of her projectiles, making them more difficult to correctly pray against. | Players should freeze the nylocas that spawn similarly to P2 to avoid any potential explosion damage. | It should be the team's goal to do enough damage to end the encounter before the green ball special attack, as its mechanics require a large amount of coordination. | If the players have enough special attack energy and Scythes, they can leave Verzik with just above 20% until the yellow attack. | Afterwards, use as many special attacks as possible to end the encounter. | With a small team or in teams without a lot of Scythes it may be easier to continue doing damage and start enrage early. | Avoiding the tornados while correctly standing on a yellow portal can give a much needed head start to finishing Verzik off before the green ball is launched.

column6: Kill The Maiden of Sugadinti without anyone in the team losing any prayer points.

column10: Completion of this achievement is calculated per acid phase, not per fight. | As such, failing once does not prevent the player from attempting again during the same fight. | Additionally, every attack counts towards the required 12; they do not need to deal damage. | There are two ways to complete the achievement; both require usage of the Woox Walk: | Stand as far from Vorkath as your weapon range allows (leaving 4 rows between the player character and Vorkath, 3 rows between the character and the exit). | A ranged weapon with a two-tick attack speed such as the toxic blowpipe or throwing darts is mandatory for this to work. | Keep count of Vorkath's attacks, prepare to act on the seventh attack. | On the same tick as he launches the special attack, move backwards one tile diagonally. | At this point, there are two possible causes of failure: the special attack may have been a freezing attack, or acid may have landed on the tiles used for Woox-walking. | In either case, it is still possible to complete the achievement in the next acid phase. | Immediately begin Woox-walking by alternating clicks on Vorkath and backwards on every tick. | Players can use the sound of Vorkath's attacks to help maintain the correct rhythm, as they occur every tick. | The achievement should be awarded just as the phase ends. | With the Combat Achievements Tasks - Failure setting turned on, the player will receive a message for being struck by a fireball or for stepping on acid, but not for performing fewer than 12 attacks. | Players can use the following strategies: | Two dragon claws specials, which lands 8 hits, and thus needing 4 more hits from other weapons. | Notably, you can combine this method with methods below (e.g. two dragon claw specials, and 2 hits with Dual macuahuitl). | A scythe of Vitur for two hits, with two specials from dragon claws | Usage of the dual macuahuitl, glacial temotli, earthbound tecpatl, or sulphur blades, though the player must have the weapon equipped before the acid attack starts.

column6: Kill Vorkath's zombified spawn without using crumble undead.
column10: The easiest way to complete this step is to use Void Knight equipment, a salve amulet(ei) and a special attack of a dark bow with dragon arrows. | Freezing spells will not work, and the delay between the spawn and the explosion is not long enough to get in multiple magic hits. | Using a dark bow special attack will likely kill the spawn within just a few attempts. | A Heavy ballista with dragon javelins is another good option. | For ironmen, a Magic Shortbow (i) with rune or amethyst arrows is another option, as the Imbued version can spec twice before the spawn hits you. | If Vorkath is killed just as the spawn is launched, the freeze effect will wear off but the spawn will persist, allowing players to kite it if needed.

column6: Kill Vorkath 5 times without taking any damage from his special attacks and without leaving his area.
column10: The player must avoid Vorkath's special attacks for 5 kills in a row; taking damage from his special attacks and getting hit by the Zombified Spawn (regardless of the amount of damage it deals) will reset the streak and fail the task. | It is recommended to count Vorkath's attacks so the player is prepared to react accordingly; every 7th attack will be a special attack. | Start walking right when the acid shoots up in the air. | The tile you're standing on will always be coated in acid, and it hits faster than you'd think given the animation. | The easiest, most consistent method is to remain 4 tiles north of the entrance during the initial 6 attacks, and evade the 7th acid pool attack by immediately moving to a tile adjacent to the entrance. | Continue moving back and forth along the few tiles adjacent to the entrance to avoid Vorkath's rapid fireballs. | The key to this strategy is the short line of tiles adjacent to the entrance which will never be covered by acid pools if you are not standing on them when the attack happens, allowing you to consistently avoid them. | Be sure to move onto the tiles during the 7th attack and not start on them. | This is harder than ranged. | Technically you can use the same tiles as in the ranged method, but you sacrifice DPS staying away from the boss, and 5 kills may strain your supplies. | You can try to melee and woox walk during it, but the random acid pattern can be difficult to dodge. | To give yourself the best odds, rotate your camera to be above your character and facing Vorkath directly, so you can see clearly where the acid droplets are going to land. | When the attack begins, move one tile backwards diagonally, and then depending on where the acid looks to be falling, find a location that will be safe to either woox walk and keep attacking, or to walk around while waiting for the special attack to finish. | Ensure you don't eat as the Ice Dragonfire attack is cast as you may incur an eat delay on your attack, causing you to not have ample time to defeat the Undead Spawn. | Equip your staff of choice that has autocast Crumble Undead on, and kill the Undead Spawn. | If it hits you and explodes, you will fail the task, even if it deals 0 damage. | Use your best gear with Saradomin brews and super restores instead of normal food.

column6: Kill Vorkath using melee weapons only.

column6: Kill Vorkath without losing any prayer points.
column10: For players familiar with 1-tick prayer flicking, this achievement is straightforward. | Otherwise, the player may simply not use prayers at all; the kill will be longer and more damage will be taken, but with high-end gear and high combat stats, this should not pose an issue. | In this instance, be sure to use a shield that protects from dragonfire, as an antifire potion alone will still result in massive damage from Vorkath's dragonfire attacks, and it is not feasible to put prayer up to flick dragonfire attacks. | Resetting the kill until landing at least one defence-reducing special attack can significantly help in reducing the kill time, reducing the amount of damage that must be tanked. | Wearing higher defence ranged gear such as Karil's or crystal will also help, if not flicking protection prayers.

equipping a slayer staff or casting a spell on Vorkath himself will fail the achievement). | Note: Recoil damage will fail the achievement. | A ring of suffering (ri) may be used for its defensive and prayer bonuses, but its recoil effect must be toggled off. | When not dodging fireballs you should face hug Vorkath for maximum DPS and tank his melee attacks. | It is recommended to maximize crush accuracy, strength bonus and to have a blue dragon or zombie task for the slayer helmet bonus – due to the lowered attack bonuses, a slayer helmet with an amulet of rancour is much more effective than a Neitiznot faceguard with a salve amulet. | Attack style should be set to accurate, unless a max hit is gained from using aggressive. | , which has the same attack speed as an unarmed player.]] | It is also highly recommended that you know how to perform the Woox Walk before trying to do this task, as it will shorten the kill time. | With best-in-slot gear, the kill should take around 10 minutes. | Note, you may splash the Crumble Undead spell if your magic attack bonus is -64 or below, so it may be useful to bring a piece of magic armour (e.g. | Ancestral robe top) when casting. | Blood moon armour and tassets can also be used if you want to avoid bringing a switch, as it has relatively small magic attack penalties. | Your inventory should consist of 3-4 super combat potion, 14-16 Saradomin brews, 1 Extended super antifire potion, 1-2 anti-venom+, 6-8 super restores and a rune pouch containing the runes for Crumble Undead (air, earth, chaos). | You may also want to bring law runes to escape or reset, either by using a divine rune pouch or replacing air and earth runes with dust runes.

column6: Kill Vorkath in less than 54 seconds.
column10: Vorkath has 750 hitpoints, and this achievement is extremely notorious for the amount of damage needed in an exceedingly short amount of time. | Avoid eating whenever possible; if absolutely necessary, use guthix rests or snowy knight mixes. | Thralls cannot be summoned within Vorkath's fight arena and Vorkath is also immune to all recoil damage, including Vengeance. | Vorkath has an attack speed of 5, or one attack every 3.0 seconds. | A special attack is queued after six auto-attacks (18 seconds), of which he will either use Ice Dragonbreath or Rapid Fire. | The former is generally recommended over the latter, since the special attack is quick to clear and allows players to resume dealing full damage to Vorkath. | By the time the other special attack is queued, players will have a few seconds after it starts in order to meet the time. | If the latter special attack starts, the player's damage will be reduced by 50% for the next ~15 or so seconds, and the time threshold is passed before the other special attack is used. | Like other challenging speed achievements, it can be highly beneficial to start the fight with a crossbow shot that activates the blood forfeit effect of enchanted ruby bolts, as it hits for 100 (or 110 with a Zaryte crossbow) damage, even if using melee. | Start the fight with a crossbow shot, and if does not activate the effect, climb over the ice chunks and back to reset the fight. | If the effect does activate, continue the fight as normal, switching to melee if using that style. | If Vorkath has more than 50% of its health by the time the first special attack starts, it is highly recommended to reset the fight. | When using ranged, a dragon hunter crossbow is recommended, with dragon thrownaxes as a special weapon swap. | While a Zaryte crossbow can deal more damage due to its increased bolt proc effect and special attack, it is slightly less accurate and is not possible to Woox walk with it. | Use both ruby and diamond dragon enchanted bolts, using ruby until Vorkath reaches ~300 hitpoints and swapping to diamond afterwards. | It is not required to be on-task; the player will be slightly more accurate using a Salve amulet(ei) with best-in-slot compared to one with a slayer task. | The advantage with ranged is that it has greater variability, especially if multiple ruby bolts proc early on. | Alternatively, due to the extreme variability of ruby bolt procs, it is also possible to complete the achievement passively over the course of hundreds of kills simply by killing the boss normally with a setup that uses a dragon hunter crossbow. | A normal kill with a considerably lucky amount of bolt procs can complete the achievement entirely by chance, without the use of any particular speed strategies or items. | When using melee, a Dragon hunter lance is required, since it is the most accurate of all the stabbing weapons. | For maximum damage output, a voidwaker or dragon claws should be used as the special, though the latter is more likely to miss given Vorkath's higher slash defence; if the player is on pace towards the time (less than 50% health after the first special attack), drink a surge potion and use a burning claws special attack. | As with ranged weapons with 7 or less range, melee players can woox walk. | Being on-task with melee provides slightly better accuracy compared to best-in-slot armour with a salve amulet. | A viable alternative melee strategy uses two special attacks from the Dragon Warhammer to start the fight, the upside being that its max hit is competitive with the likes of the Voidwaker whilst crucially also reducing Vorkath's defence. | Two successful hits will reduce Vorkath's defence by 51%, enabling much more consistent damage from the Dragon hunter lance. | This method is likely to require a lot of resetting as the Dragon Warhammer hits very infrequently, but if you can deal ~150 damage between the two attacks, your likelihood of getting Vorkath to 50% before the first special attack drastically increases. | If using this strategy, it is preferable to see the Rapid Fire special first, as you are more likely to deal enough damage to Vorkath while woox walking that you can complete the fight before seeing the Ice Dragonbreath special, and thus achieving a <54 second kill.

column6: Clear the Tightrope room without Killing any Deathly Mages or Deathly Rangers.
column10: Players will need to cross the tightrope, pick up the keystone crystal, return across the tightrope, and interact with the magic barrier to dispel it. | The mages and rangers are unaggressive at first, but immediately attack anyone crossing the tightrope, resulting in a large stack of damage being applied at once. | Dying does not fail the achievement; if a player dies with the keystone in their inventory, it drops to the floor where they died. | In groups, the mages and rangers should be distracted by other players to prevent them from attacking the crosser. | In solo encounters, it is recommended to maximise ranged defence and use Protect from Magic to minimise damage taken. | Even though the deathly rangers have a higher max hit than the mages, they are far less accurate when wearing Torag's or Justiciar armour compared to the mages with Karil's or fortified Masori armour. | Using an anglerfish or a phoenix necklace can help survive the stack of damage when crossing. | The achievement can be easily completed over multiple runs by moving the crystal as far as possible before dying, then returning and picking it up from the ground, repeating as necessary. | Telekinetic Grab can also be used once the crystal is on the ground to safely reacquire it without crossing the rope again.

column5: Putting It Olm on the Line
column6: Complete a Chambers of Xeric solo raid with more than 40,000 points.
column10: The easiest way to get this achievement is to select a "Full" layout for all rooms. | Otherwise, in order to get the minimum points needed for the achievement, the player will need to toggle large raids on as it ensures the first two floors are filled to the brim with four combat/puzzle rooms. | As the points can be slow to obtain, players should take their time and prepare early to gain more points. | Large raids can also cause duplicate puzzle rooms to appear on each floor. | If using a large layout, avoid the following rooms: | Tekton, shamans, Jewelled Crabs - these rooms provide ~1,600 points. | Look for the following rooms: | Vasa Nistirio - focus on the glowing crystals more than the boss, as they provide plenty of points. | A good strategy is to reach the point cap on the glowing crystals then finish off the boss before leaving the room. | Tightrope - each tightrope room provides ~4,000 points on average; double tightropes basically knock out 20% of the required total. | Ice demon - gather 6 piles of kindling then light each brazier and double lighting two. | This will yield ~6000 points before combat. | A 7th pile will yield 50% points ~600. | Thieving - Gather 39 grubs to hit the point cap, yielding ~4750 points. | Bats will yield an extra 300 points. | Guardian (Chambers of Xeric) - Keeping one guardian alive and having them shove you away from the door gives 40 points. | This can be done indefinitely until you reach a comfortable point cap if you do not feel comfortable doing this task without dying. | This strategy can be done as long as the guardians are not the first room in the raid. | Players without 90+ Herblore may also want to have a layout that contains an Overload (+) dropping boss, of which Tekton, Vasa, the Muttadiles and Vanguards drop. | Ideally one of the latter two should be selected for this as they provide slightly more points. | Potions give full points for 5 doses then half points for the next 5. | If possible drink only Overload (+) potions before entering Great Olm. | It should be possible to drink 3-4 doses granting 450-600 points. | The Great Olm will provide roughly 18,500 points and thus it is recommended players ensure that the first two floors will give them at least 22,000 points. | Deaths after getting over 5,000 points will likely prevent the player from completing the achievement, although the raid should be completed anyways for the potential rewards. | As a result, it is important not to die, which will also unlock the Undying Raider and Undying Raid Team if not completed.

column6: Kill the Great Olm in a solo raid without letting him use any of the following special attacks in his second to last phase: Crystal Burst, Lightning Walls, Teleportation Portals or left-hand autohealing.
Kill the Muttadile without letting her or her baby recover hitpoints from the meat tree.
column10: For solo-run attempts, be sure raid scaling is set to "0" for the easiest fight, as scaling a raid to "1" doubles boss health. | It is possible to complete the achievement without cutting the tree. | By using ice spells, or a Zamorak godsword the muttadiles can be frozen when they reach 50% hp. | This stops them from reaching the tree if they can be killed quickly. | If chopping the tree instead, pray accordingly to the smaller muttadile's attacks as it will navigate around the tree to melee the player. | Ensure the tree is completely chopped before the small muttadile reaches 50% hp.

column6: Kill the Abyssal Portal without forcing Vespula to land.
column10: Despite the name, redemption is not required to complete the achievement. | By attacking the portal, Vespula will fly into an enraged state and rapidly jab everyone next to her for heavy melee damage. | Players underneath her will be spared from this attack, but she will apply rapid stomp damage dealing up to 8 damage per tick until they leave. | By using Redemption with level 90 Hitpoints or higher, the player can use Redemption to restore health instead of using actual food. | Using Redemption will drain all of the player's prayer points when they fall below 10% of their maximum Hitpoints level (9 or lower at level 90). | To restore prayer, either drink prayer restoration potions or drink a dose of Prayer enhance (+). | The latter has to be made with 78+ Herblore or be obtained as a drop from the magic vanguard, Tekton, or the Muttadiles. | Set quick prayers to Redemption and magic/ranged boosting prayers depending on the combat style being used. | Attack the portal once and then run out of Vespula's melee range. | The portal is 8 tiles away from the movable area and will require the use of the long range setting for crossbows and powered staves. | The player should be out of Vespula's range after Redemption activates, upon which they restore prayer points, activate quick prayers and run back in, repeating until the portal is destroyed. | If Redemption is not being used, it is important to heal up upon reaching <30 health, although this is only done when the player has made potions beforehand. | For solo-run attempts, be sure raid scaling is set to "0" for the easiest fight, as scaling a raid to "1" doubles boss health.

column6: Kill Vasa Nistirio before he performs his teleport attack for the second time.
column10: For solo-run attempts, be sure raid scaling is set to "0" for the easiest fight, as scaling a raid to "1" doubles boss health. | Successful dragon warhammer or Bandos godsword hits will help increase the player's accuracy against Vasa. | Use powerful ranged weapons to take him down as quickly as possible - either a twisted bow with dragon or amethyst arrows, a crystal armour set with the bow of Faerdhinen or a toxic blowpipe with dragon darts. | A strong stab weapon is also encouraged to deal with the glowing crystals quickly, as not disabling them fast enough will cause Vasa to perform his teleport attack. | Vengeance at high health can be used against the teleport attack to rebound massive amounts of damage back onto him.

column6: Kill Tekton before he returns to his anvil for a second time after the fight begins.
column10: Defence-draining weapons such as the bandos godsword or dragon warhammer are recommended for this achievement due to their accuracy and ability to hit high. | Tekton will automatically return to the anvil if no one is in range when he scans or after attacking for a while, restoring some of his health and drained stats in the process. | Try to avoid forcing Tekton returning to the anvil as it will reduce the amount of hits the team can land. | Tekton is weakest to crush attacks so using an elder maul, or inquisitor mace is recommended, with a zamorakian hasta/dragon hunter lance as last-ditch alternatives. | Inquisitor's armour helps complement the crush-based style with accuracy and damage bonuses, which should help deal plenty of damage to Tekton if he has been successfully debuffed. | For solo-run attempts, be sure raid scaling is set to "0" for the easiest fight, as scaling a raid to "1" doubles boss health.

column6: Receive kill-credit for a Lizardman Shaman without taking damage from any shamans in the room.
column10: Only one shaman needs to be killed to complete the achievement. | The simplest strategy is to use Ranged with Protect from Missiles, staying out of melee range while running around to avoid their attacks. | Players should run from their previous position whenever a shaman jumps (move at least 2 tiles), shoots a green poison blob (move at least 3-4 tiles), and whenever the shamans' purple spawns get near. | Bring a superantipoison and a stamina potion. | This can be made easier in a solo by waiting until one of the two shamans is on the farthest side of the room as it may not aggro onto the player for a while, allowing the other one to be killed on its own. | Alternatively, safespots can be used to kill the shamans without them being able to retaliate back. | However, they will often need to be engaged first and one of the three potential layouts has very poor safespotting that will likely result in both shamans aggro'ing a player in the process. | Manipulate the shamans into performing their jump attack (3x3 AoE centred on the target at the time of the mechanic) at the designated area; once the shaman has been lured, use a weapon with a range of 10 to kill them off. | As the raid does not need to be completed, the player can choose to reload the raid until Shamans appear as the first room and use a full set of Shayzien armour while praying Protect from Missiles in order to trivialise this combat achievement.
